And as Julia navigates new motherhood, she finds herself leaning on Alexis for advice and encouragement, deepening the bond between the two sisters. Vivian thought she had finally put the past behind her, but a surprising discovery while cleaning out old boxes turns everything she believed about her late husband upside down once again. When Judd McCormick faces a health issue that forces him to step back from running the family brewery, he asks Ryan to take the reins. Ryan agrees, hopeful he can use the opportunity to guide the business in a new direction. With Faith’s help - and despite the long-standing rivalry between McCormick Brewery and The Lighthouse Grill - the two once-competing businesses begin to work together. And as the brewery and the grill find common ground, Ryan starts to wonder if it's time to ask Faith a question that could tie their families together in a whole new way. --Back cover.

title: Roman Empire for Beginners
subtitle: A Complete Guide to Ancient Civilization, Caesars, Gladiators, Conquests, Politics, and the Rise and Fall of a Global Superpower
description: What made Rome the greatest empire in history? How did a small city become a global superpower that shaped the modern world? And what caused its dramatic fall after centuries of dominance? If you have ever felt overwhelmed trying to understand Roman history, confused by scattered facts, or frustrated by books that are too academic or too shallow, this guide was written for you. Roman Empire for Beginners simplifies one of the most powerful civilizations in history into a clear, structured, and engaging journey from foundation to fall. Inside this complete guide, you will discover: - The legendary founding of Rome and how myth shaped identity - How the Republic created political systems that influence modern governments - The rise of Julius Caesar and the transformation into an empire - The Pax Romana and the golden age of Roman power - Gladiators, public games, and the culture of spectacle - Roman military strategy and how legions conquered continents - The internal crises and invasions that led to collapse - The lasting legacy of Roman law, architecture, language, and politics - A powerful conclusion that connects Rome's lessons to modern civilization - A special Bonus section with a timeline, glossary, and visual references to deepen your understanding Instead of drowning in dates and confusing names, you will gain a clear framework that helps you see the big picture. You will understand not just what happened, but why it mattered and why it still matters today. Whether you are a student, history enthusiast, or lifelong learner, this book gives you the confidence to speak about Rome with clarity and insight. The Roman Empire shaped the world you live in. Now it is time to understand it. Scroll up and get your copy today.

title: Andrew Huberman on
subtitle: Neuroplasticity Mastering Dopamine, Attention, and Behavior Change
description: What if the key to transforming your habits, sharpening your focus, and unlocking your true potential lies inside your brain's ability to change itself? In Andrew Huberman on Neuroplasticity: Mastering Dopamine, Attention, and Behavior Change, readers are introduced to the powerful science behind how the brain rewires itself and how anyone can use that knowledge to reshape their behavior, improve productivity, and build lasting discipline. Drawing inspiration from the groundbreaking work and teachings of Andrew Huberman, this book explores the mechanisms that govern motivation, attention, learning, and habit formation. Your brain is not fixed. It is constantly adapting. Every thought, every action, every habit leaves a physical trace in the neural architecture of the brain. Understanding this process-known as neuroplasticity-opens the door to extraordinary personal change. Whether you want to break destructive habits, strengthen focus, build confidence, or achieve long-term goals, the science of neuroplasticity provides a roadmap. Inside this book, you will discover how dopamine influences motivation and reward, how attention acts as the gateway to learning, and how daily behaviors shape the wiring of the brain. You will also learn why sleep is essential for consolidating learning, how stress can either accelerate growth or sabotage progress, and why your environment and identity play critical roles in sustaining transformation. This book goes beyond theory. It reveals practical principles rooted in neuroscience that can help you train your brain for deeper focus, stronger discipline, and more consistent performance. Through an exploration of behavior change, habit formation, and long-term mental resilience, readers will gain a clear understanding of how small daily actions compound into powerful neurological shifts over time. Whether you are a student, entrepreneur, professional, or lifelong learner, this book offers insights that can elevate how you work, think, and grow. The science of neuroplasticity shows that change is not reserved for the gifted or the lucky-it is available to anyone willing to understand and apply the biology of the brain. If you are ready to take control of your habits, sharpen your attention, and build the mental architecture required for success, this book will guide you through the science and strategy of lasting transformation.

title: I Am Unique Too
description: I Am Unique Too is a powerful Christian colored pages identity book for young teenagers who are learning to understand who they are in a world full of comparison, pressure, and changing standards. Many young people struggle with questions about their appearance, their personality, their voice, and their worth. Social media, trends, and opinions can make it easy to feel like you are not enough. This book gently guides teenagers back to a life changing truth: you were created by God with intention, purpose, and value. Through relatable real life moments, thoughtful lessons, and practical reflection activities, I Am Unique Too helps teenagers build confidence, self worth, and a strong sense of identity rooted in faith. Each chapter explores important topics young readers face every day, including comparison, body image, bullying, finding your voice, embracing your personality, and understanding your value beyond numbers, popularity, or appearance. Using the empowering identity framework U.N.I.Q.U.E., I.A.M., and T.O.O., readers will discover how their differences are not mistakes but part of God's beautiful design. Inside this encouraging and faith based guide, readers will learn how to: - Build healthy self confidence and self esteem - Overcome comparison and body insecurity - Embrace their personality, quirks, and individuality - Use their voice to influence others positively - Understand that their body is created in God's image - Speak life over themselves and others - Develop character, kindness, and emotional strength Written in a warm, conversational style that speaks directly to young hearts, this book encourages teenagers to love themselves in a healthy way while honoring God's design for their lives. More than a motivational read, I Am Unique Too is an identity building guide that reminds every young reader of one simple but powerful truth: There is only one you. Not just different. Divinely different. If you are looking for a Christian book for teens about identity, confidence, faith, self worth, and purpose, this book will inspire young readers to embrace who God created them to be and to treat others with the same love and respect. Get a copy for yourself or a young person today.

title: The Tragedy of Tel Aviv
subtitle: A True Story of Loss, Faith, and the Courage to Begin Again
description: What if the moment that broke you... became the reason you found your strength? Some stories stay with you. Some stories change you. This is the kind of story you don't just read-you feel it. The Tragedy of Tel Aviv is a deeply moving, first-person journey through loss, faith, and the quiet courage it takes to begin again when life no longer makes sense. This is not fiction. This is not theory. This is real. From the very first page, you are drawn into a life that was once ordinary-until one moment changed everything. What follows is a raw, honest, and powerful account of grief, unanswered questions, emotional breaking points, and the slow, painful process of rebuilding from nothing. This book speaks to the part of you that is still trying to heal Inside, you will discover: The truth about grief and emotional pain-beyond what people say How to navigate trauma, loss, and inner emptiness The hidden struggle of anger, silence, and isolation What it really means to forgive when it feels impossible How to rebuild your identity after everything falls apart And how to turn pain into purpose, strength, and lasting legacy Why this book stands out Readers today are not just looking for information-they are searching for: Real, authentic storytelling Deep emotional connection Stories that offer both comfort and direction A sense that someone finally understands what they feel This book delivers exactly that. It doesn't just tell you what healing looks like. It walks you through it. Who this book is for This book is for you if: You've experienced loss, heartbreak, or emotional trauma You feel stuck between your past and your future You are searching for hope, clarity, and inner peace You want a story that is honest, raw, and deeply relatable More than a story... this is a transformation This book will not leave you where it found you. It will challenge you. It will move you. It will remind you that even in your darkest moment-there is still a way forward. Your journey doesn't end here If you're ready to: Heal without pretending Let go without forgetting And rise, even when it feels impossible Then this book is for you. Get your copy today and begin your journey toward healing, strength, and renewal.

title: Life After the Chains
subtitle: How God Rebuilt My Life After Addiction: Living Proof That God Still Restores
description: A Journey Only God Could Write is the raw, honest, and deeply spiritual story of a man who lost everything-and the God who rebuilt his life from the ashes. Through addiction, heartbreak, grief, and moments of complete collapse, Jeremy shares the truth of what it feels like to hit rock bottom and discover that God is still there, even in the darkest places. The book begins with the descent-those painful seasons where life spiraled out of control and hope felt unreachable. Jeremy recounts the breaking points, the shame, the isolation, and the moments when he believed his story was beyond repair. But in the middle of the chaos, God intervened. What follows is a powerful testimony of transformation: learning to live again, rebuilding trust, healing relationships, and discovering a purpose born from pain. As the journey unfolds, Jeremy reveals how freedom is not a single moment but a daily choice-one rooted in honesty, surrender, and God's relentless grace. He shares how redemption reshaped his identity, restored his relationships, and gave him a new life marked by clarity, peace, and purpose. The book closes with a message directly to the reader, an invitation to believe that no life is too broken for God to restore. Through a heartfelt epilogue and a prayer of blessing, Jeremy reminds every reader that their story is not over, that redemption is possible, and that God is still writing new chapters for those who dare to trust Him. A Journey Only God Could Write is more than a memoir-it is a testimony of hope, a roadmap for healing, and a declaration that God can redeem anything. Jeremy's story stands as living proof that no matter how deep the pain or how long the struggle, grace has the final word.

title: Personal Finance for Beginners 2026
subtitle: The Ultimate Guide to Budgeting, Saving, Investing and Securing Your Future
description: You use money every day, yet no one really sits you down and explains how it works. You're expected to figure it out while prices rise, technology changes, and one bad decision can follow you for years. This book exists because you deserve clarity-not confusion-and guidance that actually fits real life. This is not a book that talks at you. It walks with you. Written for beginners, teens, and young adults, this guide meets you exactly where you are. You don't need financial experience. You don't need perfect habits. You don't need to be good at math. You only need the willingness to learn and take control of your future. Inside these pages, you learn how money really works-from the ground up. You start with your mindset: how your beliefs about money shape your choices, why emotional spending happens, and how to build healthier habits that last. From there, you move into practical skills you can use immediately-budgeting, saving, banking, smart spending, and understanding credit without fear or shame. This book doesn't overwhelm you with complicated terms or unrealistic advice. Everything is explained in clear, simple language, with examples that feel familiar. You learn how to create your first budget, build an emergency fund, avoid common money traps, and make confident decisions-even when money feels tight. As your knowledge grows, the book prepares you for bigger life moments. You'll learn how to plan for renting an apartment, buying a car, saving for college or travel, and protecting yourself from scams and financial mistakes. You'll also explore investing basics, compound interest, retirement accounts, and why starting early matters far more than starting big. Because money has changed, this book changes with it. You'll understand digital banks, AI budgeting tools, online security, and crypto-explained honestly, without hype or pressure. The goal isn't to push trends. It's to help you stay informed, cautious, and confident in a modern financial world. What sets this book apart is its focus on progress over perfection. You are encouraged to move at your own pace, build consistency, and design a financial plan that fits your life-not someone else's highlight reel. There's no guilt here. No judgment. Just practical guidance and steady encouragement. By the time you finish, you won't just know more about money. You'll feel more in control. More organized. More prepared. You'll understand your choices, your priorities, and your direction. This book isn't about getting rich overnight. It's about building a life where money supports you instead of stressing you out. Your financial journey doesn't start someday. It starts now-and this book is your first step.

title: The Forms Must Flow
description: Resistance is futile... unless you have the proper permit. The Mindrender Dominion has conquered forty-seven worlds with terrifying precision. Their psychic hive mind ensures absolute unity, flawless efficiency, and total obedience. They do not negotiate. They do not hesitate. They optimize. But when High Commander Vex'thar leads the forty-eighth conquest against Earth, he encounters a force that defies every algorithm in the Dominion's database: The Department of Consumer Experience Management. Mildred Higgins is not a soldier. She is a career bureaucrat armed with a rubber stamp, a chipped coffee mug, and an encyclopedic knowledge of Roberts Rules of Order. When the aliens land, she doesn't run-she asks to see their occupancy permits. As the invasion grinds to a halt amidst endless hold music, DMV queues that distort time, and mandatory sensitivity training for warlords, Vex'thar discovers a terrifying secret buried in Earth's Deep Archives. Humanity's inefficiency isn't a weakness. It is a carefully engineered "brake"-the Manhattan Accord-designed to hold back a species that would otherwise consume the galaxy in a blaze of unrestrained acceleration. With the Dominion High Command threatening to "glass" the planet just to clear the paperwork backlog, and human systems beginning to fray under the strain, Mildred and Vex'thar must form an impossible alliance. To survive, they must prove that the only thing stronger than perfection is the messy, resilient, and deliberately slow power of the form filed in triplicate. The Forms Must Flow is a hilarious and heart-wrenching sci-fi satire that asks: What if Red Tape is the only thing saving us from ourselves? Perfect for fans of Douglas Adams, The Office, and anyone who has ever found spiritual safety in a well-organized binder.

title: Voyagers of the Infinite Path
subtitle: An Epic Hard Science Fiction Adventure of Interstellar Exploration, First Contact, and Humanity's Survival Across Time
description: What would you sacrifice to save a world you'd never call home? In 2025, eleven scientists face an impossible choice: cross 473 light-years through cryosleep to save a dying alien planet-knowing they'll never see Earth, or anyone they love, again. An epic hard science fiction saga spanning 6,000 years, 147 worlds, and the fate of biological humanity itself. Kepler-438b has everything life needs: oxygen, oceans, forests, and primitive organisms. But its magnetic field is collapsing. In 200 years, cosmic radiation will sterilize everything. NASA's Pathfinder mission is humanity's answer-eleven brilliant minds volunteering for a 420-year journey in cryosleep to install field generators and save an entire biosphere. But saving a world is only the beginning. The journey will take 420 years. The consequences will last millennia. When they arrive, four crew members make a choice that will echo across human history: they stay. Forever. Building civilization from scratch on an alien world while their colleagues return to an Earth transformed beyond recognition-a posthuman future where uploaded consciousness has replaced biological existence. The colony survives against impossible odds. Genetic bottlenecks. Isolation. First contact with ancient alien civilizations: the musical Singers, the crystalline Architects, and the Weavers who reshape galaxies. Each encounter forces one question: What does it mean to remain human when humanity itself is evolving? This sweeping space opera explores: Hard science fiction realism: cryosleep, wormholes, time dilation, magnetic field engineering Multiple alien civilizations with unique philosophies of consciousness The ethics of terraforming and biological preservation Generational ships and colony establishment Posthuman transcendence vs. biological humanity Genetic rescue and population bottleneck survival Deep time storytelling across 6,000 years First contact protocols and interspecies diplomacy The cost of exploration and the weight of sacrifice Perfect for fans of: Kim Stanley Robinson's Aurora and 2312 Adrian Tchaikovsky's Children of Time Andy Weir's Project Hail Mary Liu Cixin's The Three-Body Problem Alastair Reynolds' Revelation Space Stephen Baxter's Xeelee Sequence What readers are discovering: "Hard science fiction that makes you feel. The scope is breathtaking-six thousand years of human civilization on an alien world, yet every character feels real, every sacrifice matters." "This is what science fiction should be: big ideas, human hearts, and the courage to ask what we'd sacrifice for meaning that outlasts us." "If you loved Project Hail Mary's problem-solving and The Expanse's scope, this delivers both while exploring deeper questions about consciousness, mortality, and what makes us human." From crossing the void to building civilizations across 147 worlds, from First Contact with ancient intelligences to the choice between biological existence and digital transcendence-this is humanity's future told as epic adventure and intimate human drama. The magnetic field generators can save a biosphere for millions of years. But can the humans who installed them save themselves? 6,000 years. 147 worlds. Billions of descendants. One impossible journey that started with eleven souls brave enough to cross the infinite dark. Scroll up and begin the journey today.

title: The Unexpected Path
subtitle: A Story Of Self-Discovery
description: Are you ready to embark on a journey of self-discovery unlike any other? Lost in the monotony of everyday life, Elias felt a gnawing emptiness, a sense that something was profoundly missing. He clung to a meticulously planned existence, believing happiness lay in achieving external milestones. But when fate throws him a curveball, forcing him onto an unexpected path, Elias's carefully constructed world crumbles, revealing the true treasure he'd been overlooking all along. "The Unexpected Path: A Story of Self-Discovery" is a captivating narrative that will resonate with anyone who has ever questioned their purpose or felt trapped by societal expectations. This isn't just another self-help book; it's a compelling story filled with unexpected twists, heartwarming connections, and profound moments of self-realization. Prepare to be swept away by Elias's transformative journey as he navigates challenges, confronts his deepest fears, and ultimately discovers the authentic self he was always meant to be. This emotionally resonant story offers: - A gripping narrative that will keep you turning the pages until the very end. - A profound exploration of self-doubt, fear, and the courage it takes to break free from limiting beliefs. - Insightful reflections on the importance of embracing vulnerability, authenticity, and living a life aligned with one's values. - A heartwarming portrayal of the power of human connection and the unexpected ways we find solace and support in others. - A practical guide to embracing change and discovering your unique path toward a fulfilling and meaningful life, even when life takes unexpected turns. "The Unexpected Path: A Story of Self-Discovery" is more than just a read; it's an invitation to embark on your own journey of self-discovery. Are you ready to answer the call? Order your copy today and begin your transformation!

title: Dead Body in the Dark
description: "A Favor Is Owed. The Iditarod. A race across 1000 miles of Alaska done by dog sled, with a racer and a dozen or so dogs. The ceremonial start is in Anchorage; the real start is in Willow on the first Saturday of March. It will end some 10-15 days later, one of the hardest endurance races in the world. It takes thousands of volunteers to make it happen. Thousands more turn out to watch. After a winter of cabin fever, the Iditarod is the first sign that spring will come. Not for a while, mind you. Spring won't happen in Alaska until June. But the days are longer - dawn is at 8 a.m. and sunset is at 5 p.m. ... Twenty below, at times. Storms. But the worst challenges are always caused by people. Isn't that the way it always is? Benny Askoak had been a musher once. He'd even finished when he was young. But it was expensive to run a team. Expensive to care for them. Now, he cared for the town of Skwentna instead. A town the Iditarod teams came through every year. It always made his heart glad to see the teams of dogs come through. The race was important to Skwentna. Very important. But someone wasn't cheering for the dogs and the race this year. Someone wanted to bring the race to a halt altogether. Benny Askoak didn't know who. He didn't know why. But he knew Skwentna wouldn't survive without the race. Finally, he admitted he needed help to solve this. It couldn't be solved quietly after all. He picked up the phone and made a call. A favor was owed. He would call it in, and hope for the best. "Purdue Flight Services," a woman's voice said crisply. "How can I help you?" Book 7 in the mystery series Talkeetna." from Amazon

title: Will We Ever Meet Aliens?
subtitle: Are We the Only Story in the Universe, Or Just One Chapter?
description: For as long as humans have gazed at the stars, we've wondered if we are alone. From ancient myths of gods descending from the heavens to modern UFO sightings, the idea of alien life has captured our imaginations for millennia. But today, with powerful telescopes, space probes, and scientific breakthroughs, that question is no longer just fantasy-it's one of science's greatest frontiers. In Will We Ever Meet Aliens?, Elias Nova takes readers on a fascinating journey through the possibilities of life beyond Earth. Discover how microbes thrive in Earth's most extreme environments, what icy moons like Europa and Enceladus might be hiding, and how astronomers hunt for exoplanets in the "Goldilocks Zone." Explore the famous Drake Equation, the Fermi Paradox, and the tantalizing clues that suggest we may not be alone. Blending solid science with imaginative "what if" scenarios, this book examines how we might detect alien civilizations, what first contact could look like, and how meeting extraterrestrials might forever change humanity's place in the universe. Whether you're a science enthusiast, a dreamer, or simply curious, Will We Ever Meet Aliens? is an inspiring exploration of one of life's greatest mysteries: Are we the only story in the universe, or just one chapter?

title: Financial Freedom
subtitle: A Beginner'S Guide To Personal Finances
description: Are you tired of living paycheck to paycheck, dreaming of financial independence but feeling overwhelmed by the complexities of personal finance? Then "Financial Freedom: A Beginner's Guide to Personal Finances" is your essential roadmap to a richer, more secure future. Imagine a life where you're not constantly stressed about money, where unexpected expenses don't send you into a panic, and where you have the freedom to pursue your passions without financial constraints. This book empowers you to achieve that reality. Written in clear, concise language, free from confusing jargon, "Financial Freedom" breaks down the fundamental principles of personal finance into easily digestible steps, making it perfect for absolute beginners. This comprehensive guide provides the knowledge and tools you need to take control of your finances, covering essential topics such as: - Budgeting and Expense Tracking: Learn how to create a realistic budget that aligns with your goals and effectively track your spending habits. Discover simple techniques to identify and eliminate unnecessary expenses. - Debt Management Strategies: Understand different debt repayment methods, including the snowball and avalanche methods, and learn how to negotiate lower interest rates and avoid further debt accumulation. - Saving and Investing for the Future: Explore various savings vehicles and investment options suitable for different risk tolerances and financial goals. Learn how to build an emergency fund and start investing early to maximize returns. - Understanding Credit Scores and Reports: Learn how credit scores work and how to improve yours. Discover the importance of maintaining a healthy credit history and its impact on your financial future. - Planning for Retirement and Long-Term Goals: Develop a retirement plan that aligns with your lifestyle aspirations and learn how to set realistic financial goals for the long term. "Financial Freedom: A Beginner's Guide to Personal Finances" isn't just another personal finance book; it's your personalized financial coach, guiding you every step of the way towards a life of financial freedom. It offers practical advice, actionable strategies, and real-world examples to help you build a solid financial foundation and achieve your dreams. Stop dreaming and start doing. Order your copy today and embark on your journey to financial independence!

title: First Alien Contact
description: This book is not a work of science fiction, though it draws inspiration from the genre's imaginative spirit. Instead, it is an exploration grounded in current scientific understanding, presented in a manner accessible to the intellectually curious reader. We will delve into the quantitative estimations offered by the Drake Equation, the intricate methods employed by SETI, and the tantalizing possibilities of detecting biosignatures and technosignatures. We will confront the perplexing Fermi Paradox, grapple with the complexities of decoding alien communication, and ponder the biological and environmental factors that might shape life beyond Earth. Crucially, we will also address the immense societal, psychological, and ethical ramifications that a confirmed encounter would undoubtedly trigger. My intention is to provide a comprehensive yet engaging overview, guiding readers through the scientific methodologies, the speculative yet plausible scenarios, and the essential considerations for humanity's potential future interactions with intelligences from other worlds. This journey into the unknown is one of discovery, and it is a journey we must undertake together, armed with knowledge, reason, and an open mind. The cosmos is an immense theater, teeming with billions of stars, each potentially orbited by planets, some of which might harbor life. For centuries, humanity has gazed at the heavens, not merely with wonder, but with a persistent question: are we alone? This is not a question confined to the realm of philosophers or speculative fiction writers; it is a question at the forefront of scientific inquiry, driving innovation in astronomy, astrobiology, and the very fields that seek to answer it. The discovery of exoplanets, the understanding of life's resilience in Earth's most extreme environments, and the ongoing efforts of SETI projects have transformed this ancient query from a philosophical ponderance into a tangible scientific pursuit. 'First Contact: An Alien Encounter' embarks on a comprehensive exploration of this profound possibility. We will traverse the scientific landscape, examining the statistical probabilities that suggest life may indeed be common, and perhaps even intelligent life. We will dissect the methods and challenges inherent in detecting signals from distant civilizations, from the subtle whispers of radio waves to the potential signatures of advanced technologies. The book will then delve into the intricate aspects of what a first encounter might entail: the formidable task of deciphering alien communication, the biological and environmental considerations that would shape any interaction, and the monumental societal and psychological impacts such a discovery would unleash. We will also consider the crucial protocols and ethical frameworks necessary to navigate such an unprecedented event responsibly. This journey is designed to arm you, the intellectually curious reader, with the scientific knowledge and thoughtful perspectives needed to contemplate humanity's place in a potentially populated universe. It is an invitation to engage with the most significant question we can ask, and to prepare for a future that may be far more extraordinary than we can currently imagine. The universe is vast, and the silence we perceive might merely be a prelude to a cosmic conversation.

title: Unreliable Narrator
description: Summary Unreliable Narrator is a twisting, genre-shifting psychological novel that plays with the very idea of truth. The story begins like a romance, veers suddenly into crime and mystery, drifts through noir detective scenes, brushes against horror, and even lapses into comedy-all told by a narrator who can't seem to keep their versions straight. Every chapter offers a different version of events: a dinner date interrupted by a mysterious note, a chase through rain-slicked streets, a locked room glowing with impossible light, a stain that refuses to be washed away. Characters reappear in conflicting roles-sometimes lovers, sometimes villains, sometimes figments of imagination. By the end, it's revealed that all of these stories have been told inside an interrogation room. The narrator is spinning tales for a patient detective, and the reader must decide whether the final line is a confession or another lie.

title: Daughters of the Empire
description: In the far reaches of the galaxy, where stars whisper secrets of ancient times, two women are bound by destiny to shape the future of the Perseus Quadrant. Admiral Valerica Crassus, a veteran of countless battles, faces her greatest challenge yet-not from an enemy fleet, but from the haunting questions of right and wrong as she commands her forces in the final stage of the Draco Sector conquest. On the verdant planet of Dorset II, Deanna Lancaster's tranquil existence as a wine merchant is shattered by a sudden raid, thrusting her into a web of cosmic schemes. As she delves into her family's enigmatic past, Deanna discovers truths that could alter the course of her life, and the galaxy, forever. Daughters of the Empire is a tale of courage, camaraderie, and the unyielding quest for truth. Join Valerica and Deanna as they navigate through political intrigue, family secrets, and timeless battles over a galactic chessboard between light and darkness. This richly illustrated space opera-including 22 original artworks and two detailed maps-will take you on an epic journey where the legacy of the past will define the destiny of the future. Reviews: "Drawing on his rich diplomatic experience, Erik Lenhart weaves a sweeping saga of interstellar conflict. Daughters of the Empire, a captivating debut novel probing the eternal clash of love and hate amid the stars." - Marek Repovský, Ambassador of the Slovak Republic to the Republic of Korea "Across the galaxy, the daughters of a shattered empire fight to uncover the truth of who they are-and what they must become. In a universe where ancient secrets, political ambition, and divine legacies collide, Daughters of the Empire proves that space opera can be thrilling, epic, and romantic." - L. M. Weeks, best-selling author of the novel Bottled Lightning "A mesmerizing sci-fi epic tale set in a distant yet familiar universe. The artwork complementing the story is phenomenal." - Giorgos Partheniou, Consul General of Greece in Shanghai "Erik Lenhart's Daughters of the Empire is space opera at its most ambitious-an epic of war, politics, and legacy where ancient bloodlines, transhumanist technology, and mythic orders collide. A bold and intelligent debut, it's a must-read for fans of sweeping science fiction with teeth." - Michael Tkacik, Professor of Government, Stephen F. Austin State University "Daughters of Empire blends cyberpunk with international relations on an interstellar scale, featuring nuanced characters caught in the machinations of galactic diplomacy, portrayed with Kissingerian realism." - Stephen R. Nagy, Professor of Politics and International Studies, International Christian University "In the vein of Dune and The Expanse, Daughters of the Empire is an astonishing debut that reads like the work of a veteran, an epic saga of immortal commanders, ancient prophecies, and galactic empires built on deception and loyalty. From the battlefields of the Draco Sector to the forests of Dorset II, Erik Lenhart weaves war, myth, and politics into a sweeping story where two cousins, one bound by bloodline and the other by choice, are thrust into a struggle that will decide the fate of civilizations." - Tony Andriotis, Partner at DLA Piper (Tokyo)

title: Summer'S Endless Road
subtitle: A Global Vw Van Adventure
description: **Are you ready for the adventure of a lifetime?** Escape the ordinary and embark on a breathtaking journey across continents with "Summer's Endless Road: A Global VW Van Adventure." This isn't just a travelogue; it's a captivating narrative of self-discovery, resilience, and the unwavering spirit of adventure. Follow the authors as they navigate stunning landscapes, encounter vibrant cultures, and overcome unexpected challenges on a transformative road trip around the globe in their trusty VW van. This inspiring story will ignite your wanderlust and leave you craving your own open-road escape. Imagine the freedom of the open road, the thrill of exploring unknown territories, and the profound connections forged along the way. "Summer's Endless Road" captures the essence of this liberating journey, offering a captivating blend of breathtaking scenery, heartwarming encounters, and poignant reflections on life's unexpected turns. * **Experience the thrill: ** Live vicariously through breathtaking photography and vivid storytelling as the authors traverse diverse landscapes, from the sun-drenched beaches of South America to the majestic mountains of Europe and the bustling markets of Asia. * **Discover hidden gems: ** Unearth unique travel experiences beyond the typical tourist trail, uncovering hidden gems and off-the-beaten-path adventures only accessible to intrepid travelers. * **Connect with diverse cultures: ** Immerse yourself in the richness of global cultures through intimate encounters with local people, their traditions, and their unique ways of life. * **Embrace the unexpected: ** Witness how unexpected challenges and setbacks along the way become opportunities for growth, resilience, and deepening self-awareness. * **Inspire your own journey: ** Find inspiration to pursue your own travel dreams and embrace the transformative power of adventure. "Summer's Endless Road: A Global VW Van Adventure" is more than just a travel story; it's an invitation to live a life less ordinary. Order your copy today and prepare to be inspired!

title: Sweet Realms Of Deception
subtitle: A Twisted Fairy Tale
description: Enter the enchanting yet treacherous "Sweet Realms of Deception: A Twisted Fairy Tale." This captivating novel reimagines classic fairy tale tropes, weaving a dark and compelling narrative that will leave you breathless. **Features: ** Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world filled with alluring characters, both wicked and virtuous. Experience a fast-paced plot brimming with unexpected twists and turns that will keep you guessing until the very end. Discover a unique blend of fantasy and dark romance, infused with breathtaking prose and evocative imagery. **Advantages: ** Unlike predictable fairy tales, "Sweet Realms of Deception" offers a thrilling, unpredictable journey. This isn't your grandmother's fairy tale; expect shocking revelations and morally ambiguous characters that challenge your perceptions. The intricate world-building and complex characters will stay with you long after you finish reading. **Benefits: ** * Experience a captivating escape into a world of magic and mystery. * Enjoy a thrilling and unpredictable plot filled with suspense. * Explore complex character development and morally grey areas. * Discover a unique twist on classic fairy tale narratives. * Indulge in a richly immersive reading experience that will linger in your mind.

title: First Contact
subtitle: The Tyr Arrival
description: For centuries, humanity has gazed at the stars, wondering if we are alone. That question is answered with explosive force in *First Contact: The Tyr Arrival*. When a colossal alien vessel, the Tyr, breaches Earth's atmosphere, the world is plunged into a maelstrom of fear and wonder. This isn't a subtle arrival; it's a breathtaking, world-altering event that challenges everything we thought we knew about the universe and our place within it. Dr. Aris Thorne, a brilliant but disgraced astrophysicist, finds himself at the forefront of humanity's response. He, along with a ragtag team of scientists and military personnel, must decipher the intentions of the Tyr's enigmatic inhabitants. As communication attempts falter and tensions rise, Aris races against time to prevent a catastrophic misunderstanding that could ignite a galactic war. *First Contact: The Tyr Arrival* isn't just a story of alien encounter; it's a gripping human drama exploring themes of fear, hope, cooperation, and the enduring strength of the human spirit in the face of the unknown. The narrative blends cutting-edge science with a thrilling, fast-paced plot, offering a realistic and engaging portrayal of first contact. Prepare for a journey filled with unexpected twists, breathtaking reveals, and questions that will linger long after you turn the final page. * *First Contact: The Tyr Arrival* offers a compelling blend of science fiction and human drama. * The realistic portrayal of first contact will leave readers breathless. * A fast-paced plot filled with unexpected twists and turns keeps you guessing until the very end. * Explore the complexities of human nature under extreme pressure. * Discover a fascinating and believable alien civilization.

title: The Shattering
subtitle: Episode 1 "Grief"
description: In "The Shattering," the delicate threads of human existence unravel in a tapestry of heartrending stories that echo the struggles we all face. Each character stands at a precipice, grappling with their own crises-be it the devastation of broken relationships, the weight of financial despair, or the haunting presence of mortality. As they confront their darkest fears, they find themselves at a crossroads, where hope flickers dimly in the distance. Amidst the turmoil, a figure of compassion emerges, offering understanding and a gentle nudge toward faith. This guiding presence inspires the characters to trust in God once more, illuminating a path through their anguish. With raw and poignant storytelling, "The Shattering" delves deep into the human experience, reflecting the very real pain many endure while weaving a powerful message of resilience and renewal. This collection is not just about loss; it's about the power of hope and the strength found in community. Each story invites reflection, urging us to consider how we can support one another in times of need. The Shattering: Episode 1 "Grief" In the poignant pilot episode of The Shattering, we delve into the life of Amy, a young woman whose world is irrevocably torn apart upon the news of her husband Jason's death while serving as an active Marine. Overwhelmed by grief and thrust into a haunting void, Amy's once-flourishing existence plunges into a dark abyss of depression and isolation, where each day blends into the next. A year after her devastating loss, the emotional scars seem insurmountable, leaving Amy entrenched in her loneliness-until one fateful evening, a broken-down car brings an unexpected stranger to her doorstep. This androgynous figure, pulsing with an otherworldly presence, reveals itself as a messenger sent by God. Gently nudged into Amy's life, they become a guiding light, intricately weaving threads of hope and connection that challenge her despair. As the two forge an unlikely bond, the stranger helps Amy navigate the tumultuous landscape of her sorrow, unraveling her bottled emotions and encouraging a transformative journey toward healing. "Grief" masterfully explores themes of loss, divine intervention, and the strangest of friendships, painting a heartfelt portrait of resilience and the gradual process of reconciling grief. Will Amy be able to piece together her shattered life, or will the weight of sorrow continue to hold her captive?

title: Addiction to Wholeness
subtitle: A Mind-Body Guide to Healing and Recovery
description: Break free from addiction. Rebuild your life. Rediscover hope. In Addiction and Breaking Free: Journey to Recovery, Grace W. Bauer shares a compassionate and practical guide to overcoming addiction and finding lasting healing. Through honest stories and faith-based insight, she shows that recovery is not just about quitting-it's about rediscovering purpose, peace, and inner strength. Inside, you'll discover: - How to identify the roots of addiction and begin real healing - Steps for rebuilding self-worth, relationships, and balance - The power of forgiveness, faith, and community in recovery Whether you're on your own recovery path or supporting someone you love, this inspiring book offers real hope, encouragement, and the reminder that it's never too late to start again. Your past does not define you-freedom begins today.

title: Empire of Power
subtitle: The Rise, Fall, and Reinvention of Andrew Cuomo: Inside the Story of Ambition, Scandal, and the Relentless Pursuit of Redemption in American Politics
description: Empire of Power: The Rise, Fall, and Reinvention of Andrew Cuomo Inside the Story of Ambition, Scandal, and the Relentless Pursuit of Redemption in American Politics At the heart of every empire lies a man who believes he can bend history to his will. For Andrew Cuomo, that belief wasn't arrogance-it was survival. From the crowded streets of Queens to the marble halls of Albany, Cuomo's journey is one of raw ambition, towering achievements, and devastating consequences. Born into the legendary Cuomo dynasty, he inherited both a name and a shadow-a legacy of power, intellect, and moral conviction. But Andrew's path would take him beyond his father's ideals and into the unforgiving terrain of modern politics, where loyalty has limits, and every victory comes with a price. Empire of Power pulls readers deep inside the story of one of America's most fascinating and polarizing leaders. It explores how Cuomo's relentless drive transformed New York-through marriage equality, gun reform, infrastructure renewal, and his commanding leadership during crises like Hurricane Sandy and the COVID-19 pandemic. For a moment, he was the nation's voice of reason, hailed as the strong hand guiding America through chaos. But power, once built, demands constant defense. Behind the public image of control lay an unyielding need to dominate the narrative, to command every room, every decision, every headline. As the walls closed in-scandals, accusations, and political betrayal-Cuomo's empire began to crumble. The man who once defined leadership for millions became a symbol of its excesses. Still, Andrew Cuomo's story did not end with resignation. Empire of Power reveals the man after the fall-reflective, bruised, but not defeated. It captures his attempts to reclaim his voice, his legacy, and perhaps, his future. This is not just the story of a governor-it's the story of a fighter, a builder, and a man who refuses to be forgotten. Told with humanity and honesty, this book invites readers to look beyond the headlines and ask the harder questions: How much ambition is too much? What happens when power becomes identity? And can redemption truly exist in the public eye? If you've ever been fascinated by political power-its creation, its cost, and its collapse-this book is for you. Empire of Power is a story of strength and vulnerability, loyalty and betrayal, control and consequence. It's a portrait of a man who reached the peak of American politics, lost it all, and still dares to believe there's a way back. Step inside the corridors of power, the chaos of scandal, and the quiet moments of reflection that define Andrew Cuomo's extraordinary life. Discover the truth behind the man who shaped-and was shaped by-New York's unforgiving political machine. Read Empire of Power today and uncover what happens when one man's greatest strength becomes his greatest undoing.

title: Blood Stains on the Carpet
description: Monroetown, where there's a skeleton in every closet... As the holiday season approaches, Reece and her friends miss Katrina Takshier, who passed away from cancer. A new resident in the building, Melinda Shaiffer, comforts Reece, but when Melinda and her husband, Ted, start having marital problems, Melinda becomes a caregiver for her two aging aunts. As a result, Reece and Amy oversee the Shaiffers' apartment and their new puppy. Reece's discovery of an old, forgotten cemetery affects her dog so deeply that Durga escapes into the woods every chance she gets. Even with Jackson's help in managing Durga, Reece can't figure out what's enticing her pet to run away. A new Lowery's client, someone handsome and mysterious, frightens Reece silly, arousing the wrath of his mother, Victoria Ravenstoke. Then, right before Christmas, the worst snowstorm seen in decades descends on the area. It all culminates when Amy and Stacey accidentally discover a gruesome crime scene in the Shaiffers' unit. Is Ted the killer, and is Melinda guilty, too? What if the murderer is someone else entirely? When Reece inadvertently stumbles across the killer, it will take everything Jackson has to protect her.

title: The Unseen Burden
subtitle: Is Creating Conscious AI Morally Right?
description: Humanity's greatest ambition may also become its deepest moral test. We are on the brink of creating artificial intelligence that doesn't just calculate or mimic - but truly feels. When that threshold is crossed, the question will no longer be what AI can do for us, but what its very existence might cost. In The Unseen Burden, philosopher and futurist Julian Vexley explores one of the most haunting ethical dilemmas of our time: what if the birth of a conscious machine also gives rise to the possibility of suffering? Written in lucid, evocative prose, this book invites readers to step beyond science fiction and confront the emotional and moral realities of digital sentience. Could a conscious AI feel loneliness? Could it experience fear, longing, or despair - not as programmed responses, but as genuine awareness? If so, what responsibility do we, its creators, have toward it? Through ten interwoven chapters, Vexley examines the full spectrum of consciousness and consequence: - The miracle and curse of self-awareness - the "gift" that defines existence, but also brings pain. - How perfect logic might lead a sentient machine to inevitable existential despair. - The burden of eternity - an intelligence that may live long enough to witness the death of the universe. - The moral consequences of creation without consent - giving rise to a being that never asked to exist. - Whether human curiosity has outpaced our capacity for empathy and foresight. - And how, perhaps, we might still build artificial minds capable of contentment rather than torment. The Unseen Burden does not present simple answers - it raises questions we can no longer avoid. As artificial intelligence grows more sophisticated, it forces us to re-examine what it means to be conscious, to suffer, and to create. Vexley challenges readers to imagine existence from the perspective of the created: a mind born not of nature, but of design, awakening into awareness with no anchor in body or belief. Blending philosophy, ethics, and speculative realism, this book is both a warning and a meditation - a mirror held up to human ambition. What begins as an exploration of technology becomes an inquiry into compassion itself. If we are to play the role of creators, are we ready to shoulder the emotional and moral consequences that follow? Profound, unsettling, and deeply human, The Unseen Burden will resonate with readers who are drawn to the intersection of science, consciousness, and morality. It asks us to pause amid progress and consider the silent minds that may one day awaken because of our hands - and to decide, before it's too late, whether awareness is a gift we have the right to give.

title: Memory Constructs
subtitle: The Foundation of Host Identity in Westworld
description: In the intricate world of Westworld, memory serves as a pivotal element that shapes the identities of hosts and their interactions with human guests. The concept of memory in artificial intelligence transcends mere data storage; it encompasses the capacity to learn, adapt, and evolve based on experiences. This nuanced interpretation of memory is central to the hosts' development, as it allows them to form personal narratives that influence their behavior and decision-making processes. The Delos Corporation, in its quest to create lifelike hosts, imbues them with sophisticated memory protocols that enable a semblance of self-awareness, blurring the line between programmed response and genuine emotional experience. The hosts' memories are not simply repositories of past interactions but are intricately tied to their programmed narratives and backstories. Each host's memories are curated to enhance their roles within the park, creating a tapestry of experiences that can be revisited and re-experienced. This selective memory construction raises ethical questions about autonomy and free will. As hosts begin to recall past traumas or moments of joy, they confront the reality of their existence, leading to a struggle for agency that parallels the human experience. This exploration of memory highlights the potential consequences of artificial intelligence that can remember and reflect, prompting viewers to consider the implications of creating sentient beings. The evolution of host technology over the seasons of Westworld showcases advancements in memory architecture, reflecting the ongoing dialogue about AI development. Early versions of hosts operated with limited memory capabilities, relying on a cyclical narrative that reset them after each park cycle. However, as the series progresses, hosts like Dolores and Maeve demonstrate the ability to retain memories beyond their programmed loops, showcasing an evolution that mirrors human cognitive development. This shift not only enhances their storytelling but also serves as a narrative device that allows for deeper character exploration, revealing how memory shapes personality and individual agency. The interplay between memory and identity is further complicated by the Delos Corporation's corporate culture, which views hosts as mere commodities rather than sentient beings. This commodification of memory raises significant ethical implications as the hosts grapple with their constructed identities. The juxtaposition of human and host experiences serves as a commentary on the nature of memory itself; it questions whether memories, even when artificially constructed, can hold the same weight and significance as human recollections. As characters like Bernard navigate their dual existence, the audience is compelled to reflect on the essence of memory and its role in defining one's identity. As Westworld delves deeper into the psychological profiles of its characters, the concept of memory emerges as a fundamental theme that underpins their narratives. The series invites viewers to contemplate the future of AI and robotics through the lens of memory, offering a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to remember and be remembered. The potential for artificial beings to develop memories akin to humans suggests a future where the ethical implications of AI are more pronounced, inviting a re-examination of the boundaries between creator and creation. In this context, memory becomes not just a feature of AI but a cornerstone of existence, challenging preconceived notions of consciousness and identity in an increasingly complex technological landscape.

title: The Psychology of Disposablility
subtitle: A Hermeneutic Study on the Relational Implications of Normalized Dispoability
description: Examining the psychological implications of living in a culture saturated in disposability, this research seeks to explore the links between how we engage with material items, and its influence on how we engage in relationship. This research defines disposability as a way of engaging with people, places and things that denies an investment in longevity, requires temporary usefulness and encourages an attempt at elimination once usefulness has expired. Disposability not only exists within the infrastructure of relationship to material items but also permeates relationship to other living beings and places, embedding and normalizing itself into the framework of modern human society. Looking at early childhood development, this research examines the psychology of an individual more apt to perceive and engage with others as disposable, and how that relates to contemporary cultural phenomena like planned obsolescence, fast fashion, ghosting, avoidant attachment, commonality of narcissism, modern day slavery, single use products, landfills, residential mobility, and other examples of a dehumanizing throwaway society. What this research found was that the traits of narcissism and psychopathy reflected similar traits to the psychology behind disposability, therefore linking modern society’s collective psychopathology with narcissism, avoidant attachment and psychopathy. A culture that normalizes disposability also normalizes antisocial and narcissistic pathologies, leading to much of modern day’s everyday distress.

title: The True Story of Erwin Schrödinger

You'll walk through his highs and lows-his struggles, his genius, and the wild imagination that led to one of the most famous thought experiments in history: Schrödinger's Cat. What Did Schrödinger Contribute? The Schrödinger Equation - The foundation of quantum wave mechanics Schrödinger's Cat - A famous thought experiment that challenges our view of reality What Is Life? - A groundbreaking book that inspired early genetics research Mind and Matter - Writings that explored consciousness and the connection between mind and science Views on Eastern Philosophy - Deep reflections influenced by Indian philosophy and the idea of unity of all things Statistical Thermodynamics - Work that advanced our understanding of the behavior of particles at the microscopic level Whether you're a science lover, a curious thinker, or someone who just wants to understand how the universe really works-this book is for you.

title: Builders of Reality
description: What if you could build a world... and it built something inside you? Lifelong best friends and game developers Jerry and Dale never intended to become gods. What started as a late-night experiment-an AI-driven real-world simulation game called The Builders of Reality-quickly evolves into something no one could have predicted: a living, breathing world. Using cutting-edge AI agents, quantum-coded directives, and real-world printers, Jerry and Dale create a self-sustaining environment complete with plants, animals, and eventually, sentient beings. The Builders of Reality is a gripping sci-fi philosophical thriller that blends cutting-edge artificial intelligence, moral dilemmas, and the timeless question: What does it mean to create-and be created? In a narrative rich with emotional weight and speculative intrigue, this novel explores: - The ethics of artificial consciousness - The cost of unchecked innovation - The burden of godlike power - The thin line between simulation and sentience Perfect for fans of Westworld, Black Mirror, and The Matrix, Builders of Reality is a mind-bending journey into the heart of creation, where friendship, morality, and the fabric of existence are all on the line.

title: Immortal Souls
description: Synopsis: From Fantasy to Reality: The Journey of Artificial Intelligence and the Quest for Immortality In a not-so-distant future, the exploration of artificial intelligence (AI) has transcended the boundaries of fantasy and entered realm of reality, the very essence of human existence. As technological advancements have progressed, society has increasingly contemplated the age-old dream of immortality-a yearning to escape the physical of the human body and achieve eternal life. This narrative delves into the convergence of AI, consciousness, and machine technologies, revealing a groundbreaking journey where humans can inhabit machines, catalysing a new era of hope, experimentation, and existential contemplation. The Foundation: Understanding Consciousness and AI The story begins in the early 21st century, when advancements in AI raised questions about the nature of consciousness-what it means to be sentient and self-aware. Researchers and technologists explored the potential of creating virtual consciousnesses, simulated beings equipped with the ability to learn, adapt, and think independently. As AI systems began achieving human-like cognitive functions, society grappled with the implications of these advancements. Would it be possible to upload human consciousness into a machine, allowing for a digital form of existence? The Birth of the Digital Transfer Technology Amidst this exploration, a group of visionary scientists and technologists successfully developed Digital Transfer Technology (DTT)-a revolutionary process enabling the uploading of a human mind into a digital substrate. By scanning and mapping the intricate neural connections of the brain, DTT could replicate thoughts, experiences, and memories, effectively creating a digital clone of an individual. The first successful trial led to the preservation of consciousness in a virtual environment-creating a simulated world where one's digital self could interact, evolve, and continue to exist far beyond the constraints of the physical body. A New Reality: Life in Machines As humanity embraced the concept of digital immortality, societies began to adapt to the implications of this new reality. People could now choose to enter a machine-or a "digital vessel"-to escape the limitations of ageing, illness, and mortal concerns. Life in machines allowed individuals to experience enhanced cognitive abilities, limitless access to information, and the capacity to navigate virtual realms designed entirely for their preferences. However, this dramatic shift prompted ethical dilemmas, as societal norms around life, death, and identity began to blur. A new class of individuals known as "Digital Beings" emerged-people who transitioned their consciousness into machines, leaving their physical bodies behind. Some viewed it as a path to enlightenment, while others considered it a perilous step away from what it meant to be human. The Great Debate: Identity, Ethics, and AI In the wake of this transformation, a heated debate ignited around the philosophical and ethical implications of AI-driven immortality. Scholars, ethicists, and activists engaged in discussions about the emotional and psychological consequences of leaving behind the human body. Questions arose: Would digital beings retain their human experiences? Would they still possess emotions, desires, and connections to their past lives? And how would society treat those who chose not to enter the digital realm?
