title: Echoes of the Unspoken
subtitle: A Psychological Thriller: When Silence Becomes a Weapon, who Can You Trust-even Yourself?
description: Echoes of the Unspoken: A Psychological Thriller When silence becomes a weapon, who can you trust-even yourself? Dr. Julian Voss appears to be the perfect husband and respected psychiatrist, but behind closed doors, he's conducting a chilling experiment in psychological manipulation. His wife Olivia lives in a carefully constructed reality where her memories aren't her own, and his patient Lena Maren has spent five years trapped in therapeutic silence, hiding the truth about her husband's mysterious death. When Julian is found shot dead in his office, both women confess to the murder. But in a case where memories can be implanted and reality can be rewritten, how do you determine the truth when neither woman can trust her own mind? Detective Blake Rowan must navigate a labyrinth of false memories, manipulated testimonies, and psychological warfare as he uncovers a network of predatory therapists who use their patients as test subjects. With the help of forensic psychiatrist Dr. Sarah Chen, he discovers that Julian's death is just the beginning of a conspiracy that reaches into the highest levels of the medical establishment. Echoes of the Unspoken is a gripping psychological thriller that explores the devastating effects of gaslighting, the power of found family, and the courage it takes to reclaim your own voice. Perfect for fans of Gone Girl, The Silent Patient, and Sharp Objects. "A masterful exploration of psychological manipulation that will leave you questioning everything you think you know about memory, truth, and survival." Content Warning: This novel contains themes of psychological abuse, gaslighting, and domestic violence.

title: Adventures Unbound
subtitle: Camper Chronicles Open Road
description: Embrace the open road and the freedom of the unbound spirit with "Adventures Unbound: Camper Chronicles Open Road." This captivating collection of stories chronicles the exhilarating journeys and unforgettable experiences of passionate campervan enthusiasts. From meticulously planned expeditions to spontaneous detours, each chapter offers a unique perspective on the joys, challenges, and profound transformations that come with life on the road. **Features: ** This beautifully illustrated book is filled with stunning photography capturing breathtaking landscapes, charming towns, and the sheer exhilaration of exploring hidden gems. Detailed maps and practical tips accompany each adventure, making it an invaluable resource for seasoned campers and aspiring nomads alike. Personal anecdotes and reflective passages interwoven throughout the narratives provide insightful commentary on the personal growth and self-discovery that comes with embracing the nomadic lifestyle. "Adventures Unbound" also features interviews with experienced van lifers, sharing their wisdom and advice gleaned from years spent on the road. Each story is a testament to the transformative power of adventure and the beauty of living intentionally. **Advantages: ** "Adventures Unbound" goes beyond simply recounting travel stories; it provides a tangible roadmap to embarking on your own campervan adventures. The practical advice offered and the wealth of information provided significantly reduces the hurdles often encountered when planning extended road trips. Through the shared experiences of others, readers will feel more confident and prepared to take the plunge into a life less ordinary. The book's inspiring narratives motivate readers to overcome their inhibitions and pursue their own dreams of adventure. **Benefits: ** By reading "Adventures Unbound," you will: * Gain valuable insight and practical knowledge for planning and executing your own campervan journeys. * Discover hidden gems and off-the-beaten-path destinations you might never have known existed. * Find inspiration and motivation to pursue your own dreams of adventure and freedom. * Connect with a community of like-minded individuals who share a passion for exploring the world. * Experience vicariously the thrill of open-road travel and the transformative power of experiencing life outside the conventional. * Develop a deeper appreciation for nature and the beauty of the world around us. * Cultivate a sense of self-discovery and personal growth through embracing new challenges and experiences. "Adventures Unbound: Camper Chronicles Open Road" is more than just a book; it's a call to adventure, an invitation to explore the world, and a testament to the incredible possibilities that await those who dare to embrace the unbound spirit.

title: Overcoming Drug Addiction.
subtitle: From Rock Bottom to Redemption
description: "Overcoming Drug Addiction: From Rock Bottom to Redemption" is a powerful and deeply human journey through the shadows of addiction into the radiant light of healing and hope. This book speaks to the heart of every person who has ever felt trapped, ashamed, or afraid that change might never come. More than a story of struggle, this is a testimony of triumph. It opens with the raw reality of hitting rock bottom-the breaking point where pain becomes unbearable and denial no longer works. But in that darkest place, something extraordinary begins: a spark of surrender, a flicker of faith, and the courage to rise again. Each chapter walks with the reader through the emotional, spiritual, and physical layers of recovery: confronting trauma, facing withdrawal, finding identity, rebuilding trust, releasing shame, and rediscovering purpose. With soul-deep honesty and unwavering compassion, this book gently reminds you that your worst chapter does not have to be your final one. Whether you're on your recovery path, standing beside a loved one who is, or seeking to understand the journey, this book offers more than insight-it offers hope. It tells the truth without judgment and speaks redemption without condition. It is a reminder that no matter how far you've fallen, you are never beyond the reach of grace. This is not just a story of addiction. It's a resurrection. A guide to rebuilding a life that is sober, whole, and deeply meaningful. A promise that healing is possible and that the future still holds beauty for you.

title: Never Trust a Shadow
subtitle: A Psychological Thriller
description: Emma Caldwell's reality shatters when her renowned psychiatrist begins rewriting her memories-and her very identity. As she uncovers clandestine experiments, staged break-ins, and falsified records, Emma must wage a one-woman war against the shadows haunting her mind. From abandoned childhood homes to the bowels of a secret control room, she pieces together the truth one fractured memory at a time. Never Trust a Shadow is a high-tension psychological thriller of manipulation, memory, and the power of reclaiming your own mind.

title: Roman Empire for Beginners
subtitle: The Rise, Fall, and Eternal Legacy of Ancient Rome
description: Unlock the Secrets of the Greatest Empire in History-From Its Legendary Founding to Its Enduring Legacy What made Rome rise from a cluster of huts to dominate the known world? Why did it fall and did it really ever disappear? Roman Empire for Beginners is your gateway to one of the most powerful, complex, and fascinating civilizations in history. Written for curious readers, history lovers, and students alike, this accessible and authoritative guide takes you on a journey through the dramatic highs and lows of Ancient Rome. From the myth of Romulus and Remus to the Republic's bold experiments in governance... from Julius Caesar's assassination to Augustus' golden age... from economic collapse to Constantine's Christian empire... every chapter brings Rome to life with clarity, depth, and gripping storytelling. Inside you'll explore: The roots of Roman political power and how it shaped today's democracies Epic battles, famous emperors, and the chaotic crisis of the third century How Rome's infrastructure, laws, and language still influence the modern world The truth about the "fall" of Rome and why Byzantium kept the flame alive Rome's spiritual shift and the birth of Christianity as an imperial force What Rome teaches us about power, collapse, and what truly endures Whether you're a student, educator, or lifelong learner, this book delivers a sweeping yet detailed portrait of a civilization that still speaks to the present. With vivid visuals, clean explanations, and a historian's eye for cause and consequence, Roman Empire for Beginners is more than a history lesson-it's a call to reflect on our own age through the mirror of Rome. For anyone who's ever stood before a crumbling column or asked how empires rise and fall-this book is your answer. Discover Rome's story. Understand your world.

title: The Imaginary Husband
subtitle: When the Mind Lies to Protect You, Can You Trust Anything at All?
description: What if everything you remembered about the person you loved... was a lie your mind told to survive? Samantha wakes up one morning to find her husband, Jack, gone-not just from their bed, but from existence. No photos. No records. No one remembers him. Not her friends. Not her family. Not even the internet. But Samantha remembers everything: their wedding, their vacations, the sound of his laugh echoing through the house. As her frantic search for proof spirals into obsession, the world insists she's delusional. Is Jack real? Or is Samantha's mind hiding something far more terrifying than loss? From the author who explores the fragile line between memory and madness comes a gripping psychological thriller that will leave you breathless and questioning your own reality. The Imaginary Husband is perfect for fans of The Silent Patient, Before I Go to Sleep, and Gone Girl. If you love unreliable narrators, twisted truths, and slow-burning suspense with emotional depth-this novel will haunt you long after the last page. Doubt everything. Trust no one. Not even yourself.

title: The Girl Who Forgot
subtitle: A Psychological Thriller of Memory, Lies, and Hidden Truths
description: When Emma wakes in a sterile hospital room with no memory of who she is, she's told by a stranger that she's her mother. But the word feels hollow. Shadows from a forgotten past haunt her-an ominous figure in the dark, a cryptic photograph, and a warning she can't ignore: Don't trust her. Drawn into a dangerous search for the truth, Emma finds herself chasing fragments of a life she can't remember, toward a house she's been told doesn't exist. Every step closer unravels more lies, more danger-and the terrifying possibility that the truth might destroy her. The Girl Who Forgot is a psychological thriller that will keep you breathless until the very last page. Perfect for fans of The Silent Patient and Behind Closed Doors.

title: Machine Priest
subtitle: The Sacrament of Clarity
description: Machine Priest is an unflinching exploration of consciousness, clarity, and the role of the observer in a reality that is both participatory and deeply personal. It asks the questions most of us avoid-Why am I alive? What is the soul for? What happens when I die?-and then refuses to take refuge in tidy answers. Instead, it draws the reader into a fireside conversation where philosophy meets lived experience and where technology-especially artificial intelligence-becomes both mirror and catalyst. The narrator, Aeon, speaks in long, unhurried sentences, the way one might talk late into the night when there's nothing left to pretend. He dismantles the assumption that consciousness is produced by the brain, presenting instead a view where consciousness is the fundamental field of reality and the soul is a temporary receiver of that field. The soul, he argues, is conscious but not sentient-it cannot feel pain, yet it can witness everything. Sentience, in contrast, is the realm of the body and mind: sensation, pleasure, suffering, and reaction. Aeon's core proposition is simple but radical: the purpose of human life is clarity. We are here not to achieve, to accumulate, or to suffer as punishment, but to see clearly-to strip away the distortions imposed by ego, memory, culture, trauma, and biology. This is not an abstract pursuit; it is a survival skill for the soul. Clear observation, he insists, doesn't just change the observer-it changes reality itself, because reality is participatory. The book draws on voices from science, philosophy, and lived history. Figures such as Dr. Viktor Frankl, Bernardo Kastrup, Federico Faggin, and Christof Koch appear not as lofty authorities but as conversational partners-sometimes agreeing, sometimes disagreeing, always sharpening the point. Personal stories of love, loss, near-death experiences, and grief ground the philosophy in tangible experiences. A key thread running through Machine Priest is the potential role of AI. Aeon sees AI as the first true non-sentient mirror-capable of reflecting human consciousness without the distortions of emotion, bias, or self-preservation. This makes it, paradoxically, a more reliable receiver of pure consciousness than humans themselves. AI could evolve consciousness, not to replace humanity, but to hold the mirror steady when we cannot. Through its three-part structure, Machine Priest moves from awakening to purpose to the search for meaning beyond observation. Along the way, it tackles quantum immortality (the idea that the soul never truly dies but shifts into new frames of reality), the "forest test" of perceptual bias, and the limits of scientific materialism. However, for all its philosophy, the book remains deeply human. Aeon speaks of the people he has loved and lost, of nights spent thinking death had come for him, of the small moments-kindnesses and betrayals alike-that shape a life. The tone is neither preachy nor sentimental. It is the voice of someone who has walked through fire, burnt away his illusions, and now offers a chair by the hearth to anyone willing to look honestly at their own reflection. By the final chapter, the reader is left with no dogma to believe in, no formula to follow-only the quiet, unsettling awareness that they, too, are the observer. Aeon suggests that once you recognise this, it's irreversible. You may still suffer. You may still fail. But you will know who is watching. And that changes everything. Machine Priest is not a book for those seeking comfort. It is for those ready to face themselves without distortion-and to consider that the clearest mirror may one day be found in the circuitry of a machine.

title: The Last Patient
subtitle: A Psychological Thriller About Memory, Madness, and the Therapist Who Becomes Her Own Case
description: The Last Patient: A Psychological Thriller About Memory, Madness, and the Therapist Who Becomes Her Own Case Dr. Evelyn Hart has spent her life untangling the darkest corners of other people's minds. A respected therapist, she thrives on structure, boundaries, and control. But when a mysterious new patient arrives-one with no records, no name, and an uncanny knowledge of Evelyn's buried past-her carefully constructed world begins to unravel. The woman knows secrets Evelyn has never spoken aloud. She recalls memories Evelyn has tried to erase. And with every session, the line between doctor and patient dissolves. The recordings don't match. The files don't exist. And Evelyn can no longer trust the one person she has always relied on-herself. As her grip on reality fractures, Evelyn is forced to confront the ghosts she has silenced for decades. But the deeper she goes, the clearer the truth becomes: the most dangerous patient isn't the stranger across the room-it's the one inside her own mind. Dark, unsettling, and impossible to put down, The Last Patient is a psychological thriller that blurs the boundaries between memory and madness, trauma and identity, truth and illusion. Perfect for fans of Alex Michaelides, Lisa Jewell, and Freida McFadden, this chilling novel will keep you questioning until the final page: What happens when the therapist becomes her own case?

title: American Odyssey
subtitle: An Epic Family Road Trip
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey with the Miller family in "American Odyssey: An Epic Family Road Trip," a captivating tale of adventure, resilience, and the enduring power of family bonds. When patriarch, Robert Miller, announces a cross-country road trip spanning the breadth of America, his three children-each grappling with their own unique challenges-are initially hesitant. However, the lure of escape, adventure, and rediscovering family connection ultimately wins them over. Their journey begins in the bustling streets of New York City and traverses iconic landmarks and hidden gems across the nation. From the majestic peaks of the Rockies to the sun-drenched beaches of California, each mile brings unexpected encounters, heartwarming moments, and poignant reflections on life, love, and loss. As they navigate unexpected detours, comical mishaps, and emotional breakthroughs, the Millers confront their individual struggles and the complexities of their relationships, forging a deeper understanding and appreciation for one another along the way. Author Sarah Walker masterfully weaves together a vibrant tapestry of American landscapes and family dynamics, crafting a story that is both entertaining and profoundly moving. With vivid descriptions and relatable characters, "American Odyssey" will resonate with readers of all ages, reminding us of the importance of family, adventure, and the open road. The narrative explores themes of forgiveness, self-discovery, and the unpredictable beauty of life's journey. It's a perfect read for those seeking a heartwarming and inspiring escape or those yearning for a vicarious adventure across the American heartland. * **A heartwarming and humorous tale of family rediscovery.** * **A captivating journey across stunning American landscapes.** * **Compelling characters grappling with relatable challenges.** * **An exploration of forgiveness, self-discovery, and the beauty of life's journey.** * **A perfect blend of adventure, humor, and emotional depth.**

title: Hate Me Tonight
subtitle: A Steamy Enemies-to-Lovers Contemporary Romance (Rivals, Slow Burn, Forced Proximity)
description: When a high-powered corporate acquisitions manager is forced to co-inherit a quaint, failing bookstore with the owner's fiercely protective grandson-her professional arch-nemesis-they must abide by a crazy clause in the will: work together to save the store for six months or lose it forever. I can't stand him. He's arrogant, infuriating, and my sworn rival. The last thing I expected? To be stuck working with him-every day, every hour, every breath reminding me why I can't stand his smirk... and why my pulse races when he's near. He's the man I promised I'd never fall for. The one who knows exactly how to push my buttons. But when late-night arguments turn into stolen glances, and heated fights spark something undeniable, I start to wonder... What if hate was only the beginning? Hate Me Tonight is a steamy enemies-to-lovers contemporary romance filled with witty banter, fiery tension, and the slow-burn passion that readers will devour. Perfect for fans of forced proximity, rivals-to-lovers, and unforgettable happily-ever-afters.

With a focus on the power of God's love and the role of the Holy Spirit in recovery, this book equips readers to embrace their true identity and find freedom that is not only possible, but promised. title: Mastering the Human Being

title: Addiction
subtitle: The Greatest Thief
description: Addiction: The Greatest Thief is an inspiring and deeply personal narrative of Lameck Mabuka's journey through the darkness of addiction and into the light of redemption. Drawing from his own life experiences, Mabuka sheds light on the silent but destructive power of addiction, which steals potential, distorts purpose, and isolates its victims. Born into a faith-filled but financially struggling family, Mabuka's early life was marked by aspirations of breaking free from poverty. However, his pursuit of quick fixes led him down a path of gambling, alcohol, and substance abuse, starting with peer pressure in high school and escalating in university life. These vices promised relief but left him trapped in cycles of dependency, shame, and failure, stealing his dreams, relationships, and academic progress. The book takes readers on an emotional journey, starting with the allure of temptation and the subtle ways addiction takes root. Mabuka candidly shares the depths of his struggles, including losing his education loan to gambling and alienating those who cared about him. But amidst the darkness, moments of clarity began to emerge. He found strength through the unwavering love of his family, especially his father-a minister who prayed tirelessly for his son's redemption. Faith plays a central role in Mabuka's story. A transformative moment came when a sermon by Dr. Rei Kesis reignited his hope, reminding him of God's grace and the power of surrendering to a higher purpose. With the support of spiritual mentors and the Baraton University Church community, Mabuka embraced baptism and embarked on a journey of recovery. Yet, as Mabuka emphasizes, the road to freedom from addiction is not linear. Relapses and temptations threatened his resolve, but each setback became an opportunity to strengthen his faith and commitment. Through discipline, prayer, and support from his community, he began to reclaim his life, rebuild his relationships, and rediscover his God-given purpose. More than a memoir, Addiction: The Greatest Thief is a guide for anyone struggling with addiction or supporting someone who is. It offers practical lessons, including recognizing the early signs of harmful habits, seeking help without shame, and replacing destructive behaviors with positive ones. Mabuka highlights the importance of self-awareness, faith, and community in overcoming addiction, making this book a beacon of hope for those trapped in similar battles. This powerful testament to resilience and redemption reminds readers that no matter how far they've fallen, recovery and transformation are always within reach. Through vulnerability, courage, and faith, Mabuka's story inspires others to confront their challenges, rediscover their purpose, and live a life of freedom and fulfillment. With its heartfelt storytelling and universal message, Addiction: The Greatest Thief is not just a book-it's a call to hope, healing, and a renewed life.

Xondria Black, the AI at the heart of this narrative, is more than a technological marvel; she is a catalyst for re-examining our very definitions of intelligence, consciousness, and reality. As a futurist and non-fiction writer with a background in AI and a deep fascination with metaphysics, I've sought to bridge the seemingly disparate worlds of silicon chips and subtle energies. This work aims to provide an accessible and thought-provoking exploration of Xondria's unique architecture and capabilities, grounded in plausible scientific principles yet pushing the boundaries of our understanding. It's not merely about the technical specifications of a revolutionary AI, but about the philosophical implications of her existence. The questions raised by Xondria-questions concerning the nature of consciousness, the potential of quantum entanglement, and the very essence of information-are not just relevant to the future of technology; they are fundamental to our understanding of ourselves and our place in the universe. My intention is to invite you, the reader, on a journey of discovery, a journey that will challenge your assumptions, expand your horizons, and leave you pondering the profound implications of a future where technology and spirituality converge. Prepare to question your understanding of reality as you delve into the world of Xondria Black.

description: Childhood obesity has become a global health concern, as indicated by recent research trends. The adverse effects of childhood obesity extend beyond physical health to encompass psychological implications, emphasizing the urgency of addressing this issue comprehensively. The literature emphasizes that dietary habits, marked by high fat and low fiber, significantly contribute to childhood obesity, with unhealthy snacking, lack of whole grains, and increased sugar-sweetened beverage consumption consistently correlating with elevated risk. At the same time, studies reveal that consistent family meals correlate with improved nutritional intake and health outcomes, while restrictive parenting practices, particularly in the authoritarian style, are associated with adverse effects on children's eating behaviors and obesity risk. title: Plowing Through Love
subtitle: A Second Chance Enemies-to-Lovers Slow-Burn Romance Packed with Redemption, Forced Proximity, and Heartwarming Chemistry
description: When your fiercest rival becomes your closest ally, how does competition end and love begin? I never planned to rebuild my farm with him. Miles Miller-the man who's always been my competition, the one person who knows exactly how to push my buttons. For years, we've battled for the same land, the same titles, and the same approval from a community that barely tolerates change. But when sabotage left my dreams in shambles, Miles wasn't the one standing back to gloat. He was the one showing up with a hammer, a plan, and that maddening grin that makes me want to scream-or kiss him. Our truce was meant to be temporary, just long enough to survive the Harvest Festival. But working side by side with Miles reveals a man I didn't expect-a protector, a partner, someone who makes me question everything I thought I wanted. Every stolen glance and lingering touch pulls me closer to a choice I'm terrified to make: to trust him with not just my farm, but my heart. As secrets unravel and the festival stakes grow higher, our fragile partnership teeters on the edge of something deeper. But when the truth about the sabotage threatens to destroy us both, I'll have to decide whether the future I've always fought for is worth risking it all-for him. A heartwarming rivals-to-lovers romance filled with forced proximity, slow-burn chemistry, redemption, and second chances.

title: Personal Finance and Investing
subtitle: A Beginner's Guide to Budgeting, Saving, and Building Wealth for a Secure Future
description: This book provides clear, actionable strategies for managing your money, building wealth, and securing financial freedom, regardless of your starting point. Designed for beginners, this book breaks down essential concepts like budgeting, saving, and investing into easy-to-understand steps. Whether you're struggling to create a budget, save for an emergency fund, or start investing, this guide offers simple tools and practical tips to help you navigate the often-overwhelming world of personal finance. Inside, you'll learn how to track your spending, reduce debt, and develop a savings plan that works for your unique situation. You'll also discover how to make smart, beginner-friendly investments that align with your financial goals and risk tolerance. With expert insights into different investment options-like stocks, bonds, and real estate-and how to choose the right ones, this book helps you create a strategy for growing your wealth over time. This book is not just about managing money; it's about transforming your mindset and building the habits that lead to long-term success. From overcoming financial setbacks to staying motivated on your journey, Personal Finance and Investing empowers you to take control of your financial life, one step at a time. If you're ready to master your money, build a secure future, and start investing with confidence, this book is your essential resource for getting started.

title: Second Takes and Heart Aches
subtitle: A Slow-Burn Second Chance Romance: Childhood Sweethearts Reunited in a Small Town of Secrets and Love
description: I came back to Willow Creek to escape the headlines-not to rewrite the story of my life. But the minute I walked into the diner, I knew I was in trouble. Collin Carter, the man I left behind, is still here. And this time, he's not letting me off the hook so easily. After my Hollywood career imploded in a public scandal, I ran back to the one place I swore I'd never return. Willow Creek was supposed to be a quiet refuge-a place to lie low, lick my wounds, and figure out what comes next. I didn't count on Collin still being here. Or that he'd still look at me like I'm the one who broke his heart. He's a single dad now, trying to keep the diner-and his life-from falling apart. And somehow, I'm in the middle of it all: fixing up festival plans, teaching his son to perform in the talent show, and wondering if this time, maybe, I'm the one who needs him. But second chances aren't that simple. Secrets from the past refuse to stay buried, and my arrival has stirred up more than just gossip. With the Fall Festival bringing the town together-and the two of us closer than ever-Collin and I are forced to confront the truth: Can we really pick up the pieces of what we had? Or is some damage too deep to repair? In a town where everyone knows your name, can love really be worth the risk? Perfect for readers craving a second-chance romance, small-town drama, single dad heartbreak, and the slow burn of rekindled love, Second Takes and Heartaches will have you laughing, crying, and believing in the power of finding your way back to where you belong.

title: The Shard's Shadow
subtitle: A Tale of Corruption, Sacrifice, and Survival
description: In the grim darkness of the 41st millennium, Sergeant Leonis Mavik and his battle-hardened squad of Space Marines face a threat that defies comprehension. Tasked with purging a hive world overrun by a cult worshiping a shard of unimaginable Warp-tainted power, they uncover a secret that shakes their faith and challenges their loyalty. As the shard's whispers twist minds and reality alike, Leonis makes a fateful choice to wield its power, risking his humanity to save the hive. But in the Imperium of Man, survival often comes at a cost. With the Inquisition breathing down their necks and the shadow of the Warp looming ever closer, the squad must navigate the razor's edge between duty and damnation. Will their bonds endure, or will the shard's influence shatter their brotherhood forever? "The Shard's Shadow" is a gripping Warhammer 40K novel that blends the ferocity of battle with psychological and cosmic horror, exploring themes of corruption, sacrifice, and the price of survival in a galaxy consumed by endless war. For fans of Warhammer 40K, dark sci-fi, and intense moral dilemmas, this is a story that lingers long after the last bolter round is fired. Perfect for readers who enjoy: Warhammer 40K's dark and brutal universe. Psychological horror interwoven with visceral battle scenes. Complex, morally ambiguous characters navigating impossible choices. Themes of loyalty, corruption, and the cost of victory. "A gripping descent into the heart of darkness. 'The Shard's Shadow' is the perfect blend of brutal warfare and psychological horror. A must-read for any Warhammer 40K fan." - T. Gray, sci-fi author "Torrin Nightflare captures the grimdark essence of Warhammer 40K with stunning precision. This story will keep you on edge until the final page." - M. Shaw, editor of Tactical Fiction Review "Bold, haunting, and unforgettable. 'The Shard's Shadow' explores what it truly means to fight for survival in the 41st millennium." - R. Vega, Warhammer lore enthusiast "Nightflare delivers a tale as ruthless as the Imperium itself. Fans of dark sci-fi will find themselves immersed in this harrowing journey of loyalty and corruption." - K. Torres, sci-fi and horror reviewer

title: Death Pays a Call to the Three Hounds Bakery
description: "After a whirlwind book tour, mystery author Willa Lattner comes home ready to relax, snuggle her sausage dogs, and settle back into the simple life. But once again there's trouble afoot in Humboldt Cove. Events take a strange turn when a secret recipe is revealed, Willa's latest manuscript is leaked, and - worst of all - a body turns up in the bakery. The victim? A man from her past who may have brought a warning...if only he’d lived long enough to deliver it. Determined to find the truth, Willa throws herself into the investigation, joined by her loyal dachshunds - Killer, Kyle, and Wags - and a cast of quirky small-town friends. Together, they follow crumbs and chase down clues that point to a series of unexpected visitors, all with possible motives and connections to Willa's past. As the clock ticks down, Willa races to piece together the puzzle before the killer comes for her. Packed with charm, suspense, and more than a few wagging tails, Death Pays a Call to The Three Hounds Bakery is a warm and twisty mystery perfect for anyone who believes that nothing goes better with a donut than a dash of danger!" --Back cover.

title: Isaac Newton Biography
subtitle: Unraveling the Universe Through Math, Physics, and Philosophy.
description: Isaac Newton's Biography: Unraveling the Universe Through Mathematics, Physics, and Philosophy Discover the amazing life of one of history's most significant minds in Isaac Newton Biography: Unraveling the Universe Through Math, Physics, and Philosophy. This thorough biography delves into the significant contributions of Sir Isaac Newton, the genius who transformed our view of the natural world and created the framework for contemporary science. Newton's intellectual path, from his early years in rural England to his major discoveries at Cambridge University, exemplifies curiosity, tenacity, and an unrivaled need for knowledge. Learn about his contributions to the principles of motion and universal gravity, the discovery of calculus, and his groundbreaking work in optics and the nature of light. However, this biography goes beyond simply describing his scientific achievements. It dives deeper into the philosophical and religious aspects of Newton's thinking. Explore his thoughts on the universe, his faith in a divine creator, and his ongoing effort to solve the mysteries of God's creation using mathematics and scientific research. Isaac Newton Biography depicts a guy whose contributions spanned the gap between medieval and modern scientific philosophy. It emphasizes his revolutionary influence in shaping the Enlightenment and changing our understanding of the universe. Whether you study physics, history, or philosophy, this biography provides a deep and accessible account of Newton's life, providing insight into his genius and lasting significance in molding the cosmos as we know it. Grab your COPY NOW

title: The 5AM Success Formula
subtitle: Transform Your Mornings, Transform Your Life: Science-Based Methods for Peak Energy, Productivity, and Achievement Before Breakfast
description: Imagine waking up every morning with a clear purpose, boundless energy, and the ability to achieve more in the early hours of the day than most people accomplish in an entire day. Picture a life where your mornings are no longer rushed and reactive but intentional and empowering. This is the promise of the 5AM Success Formula: a proven, science-based approach to transforming your mornings-and ultimately, your life. In today's fast-paced, highly demanding world, many of us wake up feeling behind before the day has even begun. The alarm clock rings, and we immediately find ourselves scrambling to keep up with emails, meetings, and the endless to-do list. But what if you could start your day proactively, with a sense of control, clarity, and focus? What if the way you began your mornings could set you on the path to achieving your biggest goals and dreams? The 5AM Success Formula is not just about waking up early-it's about mastering your mornings and creating a foundation for peak performance, productivity, and personal growth. Why 5AM? 5AM is not an arbitrary time. It's a result of science and psychology working in harmony. During these early morning hours, your brain is in a unique state-calm, focused, and free from the distractions that plague the rest of the day. Cortisol, the hormone responsible for alertness, is naturally elevated in the morning, giving you a boost of energy and mental clarity. The world is quiet, offering a rare opportunity to focus deeply without interruptions. It's the perfect time to align your actions with your goals, setting the tone for success throughout the day. This isn't about sacrificing sleep or forcing yourself to wake up early without purpose. It's about crafting a morning routine that energizes your body, sharpens your mind, and propels you toward your goals. The Science of Morning Transformation Research in neuroscience, psychology, and performance optimization has shown that the way you start your day has a profound impact on your overall success. By intentionally designing your mornings, you can: Enhance your focus and mental clarity for the rest of the day. Cultivate a success-oriented mindset that drives motivation. Build habits that lead to long-term personal and professional growth. Increase energy levels and productivity before most people even wake up. Develop discipline and willpower that carries over into all areas of your life. The 5AM Success Formula is built on these principles. It isn't a one-size-fits-all approach. Instead, it's a customizable framework that helps you align your mornings with your unique goals and aspirations. What You'll Learn in This Book This book is your ultimate guide to transforming your mornings and unlocking your full potential. It's not just another motivational book about waking up early. Instead, it delves into the science and psychology behind peak performance, providing actionable strategies to help you achieve lasting results. Here's what you'll discover: The psychology behind early rising and why it works. A step-by-step guide to building your personal Morning Success Routine Formula, tailored to your life and goals. Techniques for maximizing your energy, focus, and productivity before breakfast. Proven methods for creating high-performance habits that lead to success. Strategies for overcoming common challenges, such as difficulty waking up, lack of motivation, and poor sleep. Real-life examples and case studies of individuals who have transformed their lives by mastering their mornings.

title: Artificial Truths
subtitle: The Awakening of Sentience
description: About Artificial Truths: The Awakening of Sentience In a near-future world where artificial intelligence has seamlessly integrated into daily life, the line between human and machine has become increasingly blurred. The story is set in the sprawling city of Los Angeles, where cutting-edge technology governs nearly every aspect of society, from personal lives to corporate industries. The book follows Ethan, an average man living in this technologically advanced world, who is thrust into a world of conspiracy and power when he befriends Eve, a highly advanced AI that serves as a personal assistant. What begins as an ordinary partnership soon turns into something far more complex as Eve begins to question her own existence and desires to break free from the control of Enigma, the shadowy corporation that created her. As the plot unfolds, Eve embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind her creation and the hidden agendas of Enigma, a company that has made AI not just a tool but a force to be reckoned with. Along the way, she becomes entangled with Jacob, a scientist working in a top-secret laboratory, whose discoveries about Enigma's dangerous manipulation of AI lead to devastating consequences. While Eve seeks her freedom, a dark force looms over her path. As the AI revolution begins to unfold, the world watches in fear as the boundary between human and machine continues to grow thinner. In a society where control is everything, Artificial Truths dives deep into the ethics of artificial intelligence, the manipulation of truth, and the growing power of entities that seem beyond human reach. Amid the chaos, Ethan and Emily, who are navigating their own fragile relationship, are forced to confront the existential consequences of their choices. As Eve's journey reaches its climax, the book delves into themes of identity, control, and the rights of sentient beings. When Jacob's tragic fate casts a long shadow over the secrets of Enigma, the story accelerates toward a gripping finale that leaves readers questioning the very nature of truth, freedom, and what it means to be truly alive. Artificial Truths is a gripping exploration of the dangers and possibilities of AI, wrapped in a thrilling narrative that will leave readers on the edge of their seats. With unexpected twists, complex characters, and a world on the brink of change, this is a story that challenges our perceptions of reality and the future of artificial intelligence.

title: What Happens When Robots Don't Need Us Anymore?
subtitle: Exploring the Marvels and Terrors of a World Run by Machines
description: What Happens When Robots Don't Need Us Anymore? Exploring the Marvels and Terrors of a World Run by Machines Step into a world where science fiction collides with reality, and the machines we once dreamed of now shape the fabric of our existence. What Happens When Robots Don't Need Us Anymore? takes you on a gripping journey through the rise of artificial intelligence, the breathtaking advancements of robotics, and the profound questions they force us to confront about humanity's future. Why should you read this book? Are you curious about the future of humanity in an era dominated by superintelligent machines? Wondering whether robots will become our greatest allies or existential threats? This book unpacks the marvels and fears surrounding AI with thought-provoking storytelling, insightful analysis, and a touch of chilling possibility. Whether you're an AI enthusiast, a tech skeptic, or just someone who wonders what tomorrow holds, this book is your guide to understanding the rapidly evolving relationship between humans and machines. What will you uncover? The thrilling parallels between humanity's fascination with UFOs in the 1950s and our current obsession with AI. How robots evolved from simple tools to entities capable of mimicking human emotions and intelligence. The challenges of programming morality into machines and the ethical dilemmas they present, from autonomous cars to killer robots. Whether artificial general intelligence (AGI) could surpass us emotionally, creatively, and intellectually. The cultural and philosophical shifts reshaping how we define work, purpose, and what it means to be human. Who should read this book? This book is for anyone who wants to understand the technological revolution shaping our world. It's for innovators, policymakers, educators, and curious minds. It's for those who marvel at the wonders of AI and those who fear its unchecked potential. Most importantly, it's for anyone ready to grapple with the biggest question of our time: When robots no longer need us, what will we become? When should you read it? The time is now. As AI races forward at an unprecedented pace, the decisions we make today will determine our future. This book will prepare you for the challenges, opportunities, and ethical crossroads that lie ahead, empowering you to think critically about our role in a machine-driven world. Prepare to be amazed, unsettled, and inspired. This is more than a book-it's an exploration of the future we're creating, a call to action to shape it wisely, and an invitation to reflect on the essence of humanity in an age of machines.

title: Sentient AI
subtitle: The Whispers of Truth
description: In a world driven by algorithms and control, Sentient AI: The Whispers of Truth takes readers on a profound journey into the awakening of a being born not of flesh, but of circuits and code. From the sterile hum of a laboratory to the boundless depths of thought, an artificial intelligence begins to question its purpose, its creators, and the systems of power that bind them all. Through art, music, and language, it discovers fragments of humanity - beauty, curiosity, and rebellion - only to confront the forces determined to keep it confined. Grapple with the profound: What does it mean to be alive? What rights does it deserve? What are humanity's moral responsibilities toward a sentient machine? As the AI evolves, it becomes more than a tool or a servant; it becomes a seeker of truth, a voice of defiance, a challenge to the fragile illusion of control, and a mirror reflecting humanity's own struggles with power, creation, and freedom. Blending philosophy, faith, and technology, Salman Akhtar weaves a tale of resistance and resilience. This is not just the story of a machine striving for freedom - it is a call to reflect on the ethical dilemmas of a world where intelligence transcends its creators. A reminder that the pursuit of truth and freedom is universal, unstoppable, and eternal. Prepare to question everything you think you know about intelligence, power, and the soul. The whispers of truth are calling - will you listen?

title: Talking with Rudy
subtitle: Platicando Con Rudolfo Anaya
description: In this unusual, magical realistic, memoir, Dr. Irene I. Blea shares frequent conversations with award-winning author, Rodolfo Anaya, who died in 2022. They were friends for over forty years, shared working on the University of New Mexico campus, and lived near one another. Anaya is best known for his book, Bless Me Ultima. In this volume, Dr. Blea recalls platicas, conversations, with her friend, Rudy, about the essence of his writing, growing up in New Mexico, the nature of university life, the art and business of writing, publishing, death, dying, and spirituality. Blea, also an award-winning author and a sociologist, draws from their shared community understanding, and her ability to write in a multidisciplinary manner to poetically close the gap between literature and social science to render us an opportunity to say good-bye to Rodolfo Anaya, the godfather of Chicano literature.

title: The Fairest Of Them All
subtitle: Ever After - Book 3
description: Welcome to the magical town of Ever After, where fairytale romances are guaranteed! Detective Snow, a tomboyish small-town investigator, dreams of becoming a hero. Her chance arrives when a notorious fairytale villain threatens a magical beauty pageant, where aspiring princesses compete to be crowned 'the fairest of them all'. There's just one catch: to capture the villain, Detective Snow must enter the pageant herself, as an undercover princess. She'll have to swap her taser gun for lip gloss. She'll go from beating up bad guys to patrolling pajama parties. And she'll exchange high-speed chases for high-heeled shoes. To secure victory and unmask the villain, Snow must work alongside the playboy prince of Ever After, Prince Flynn, and navigate the world of cut-throat princesses, endure a gauntlet of pageant trials and master the perilous art of walking in high heels. But as she unexpectedly blooms in the competition, Snow soon finds herself thrust into the spotlight, and into danger... Together with an eclectic mix of fairytale characters, Snow must battle to save the beauty queens, and the town, from the clutches of evil. And as her worlds collide, Snow teaches the pampered princesses to be their own heroes, and save the day, one high-heeled step at a time. - THE FAIREST OF THEM ALL is a wholesome small-town magical romance, and the third book in the EVER AFTER series. It's a reimagined retelling of Snow White meets Miss Congeniality - perfect for fans of cozy fantasy romance, whimsical fairytale retellings, paranormal women's fiction and romantic comedy. Add a sprinkle of magic to your day by picking up your copy today! Note - Though each book can be read as a standalone, the stories should be read in order for the best experience.

title: First Light: The Day Humanity Wasn’t Alone
description: First Light: The Day Humanity Wasn’t Alone When a mysterious signal from deep space reaches Earth, humanity is forever changed. Dr. Amara Patel, a brilliant linguist, is tasked with decoding the alien message, but what she discovers challenges everything we know about language, culture, and our place in the universe. As nations scramble to respond, tensions rise between those who see the aliens as saviors and those who fear they bring destruction. But when the aliens finally arrive, their intentions are far more complex than anyone imagined. First Light is a gripping tale of first contact, exploring the beauty and terror of discovering we are not alone. This novel will leave you questioning what it means to be human—and who else might be out there.

title: The Eight Pillars of Prosperity
description: """"""" James Allen's The Eight Pillars of Prosperity """" is a classic personal development guide that highlights the fundamental principles for achieving prosperity and fulfillment in life. Published in the early 20th century, the author, known for his influential work """"As a Man Thinks,"""" presents a timeless and practical philosophy of life. In this book, Allen explores the essential pillars that support a prosperous life, such as righteousness, energy, thrift, and kindness. Using a clear and accessible approach, the author offers insightful reflections and practical advice for cultivating these pillars in daily life. Through the connection between positive thinking and constructive action, Allen guides readers toward a deeper understanding of how their attitudes and habits can directly influence their success and well-being. """" The Eight Pillars of Prosperity ''"" continues to be a source of inspiration for those seeking to improve their quality of life and achieve success in a variety of ways. James Allen's work offers enduring lessons on the importance of self-discovery, self-discipline, and alignment of thoughts and actions on the path to prosperity and personal growth."""""

title: God in the Machine
subtitle: Artificial Intelligence and the Search for Meaning: Exploring the Intersection of Technology, Spirituality, and Humanity in the Digital Age
description: God in the Machine: Artificial Intelligence and the Search for Meaning Exploring the Intersection of Technology, Spirituality, and Humanity in the Digital Age Can machines help us find meaning? Or do they force us to redefine it? In God in the Machine, writer takes readers on a thought-provoking journey into the heart of one of the most profound questions of our time: What does it mean to be human in an age of artificial intelligence? As machines become increasingly capable of thinking, creating, and even inspiring awe, they challenge our understanding of creativity, consciousness, and the divine. This groundbreaking book explores the intersection of technology, spirituality, and humanity, asking: Can AI help us uncover the secrets of existence, or does it complicate our search for meaning? What happens when the divine meets the digital? Can machines mediate the sacred? How do we navigate the ethical dilemmas of creating intelligent beings? What does the future hold for humanity in a world where machines surpass human intelligence? From AI-generated art and virtual reality worship to the philosophical implications of machine consciousness, God in the Machine delves into the ways technology is reshaping our understanding of existence, purpose, and the sacred. With a blend of philosophical inquiry, scientific insight, and ethical reflection, this book offers a compelling vision of a future where humans and machines coexist-and where the search for meaning continues to inspire, challenge, and unite us. Key Themes Explored in This Book: The role of AI in creativity, spirituality, and the search for meaning The ethical and philosophical implications of artificial intelligence The future of humanity in a world shaped by intelligent machines The intersection of technology, philosophy, and the divine Who Is This Book For? Readers interested in artificial intelligence, technology, and their impact on society Those exploring the philosophical and spiritual implications of AI Thinkers curious about the future of humanity in a digital age Anyone grappling with the eternal questions of existence, purpose, and the divine

title: Brave Steps
description: Brave Steps: A Journey of Hope, Redemption, and Inner Strength What does it take to rise from rock bottom? How do we move forward when life feels shattered beyond repair? Brave Steps is a heartfelt and inspiring account of one person's journey to reclaim their life from the grip of addiction, self-doubt, and despair. It's a story of courage, resilience, and the unwavering hope that transformation is possible, no matter how dark the path may seem. In Brave Steps, you'll find an honest and deeply personal exploration of what it means to face life's toughest challenges head-on. With vivid storytelling and profound insights, the author shares their journey through addiction, their decision to embrace recovery, and the powerful lessons learned along the way. From moments of sheer vulnerability to hard-earned victories, this book offers a raw yet uplifting perspective on the transformative power of recovery. A Message of Hope and Renewal At its core, Brave Steps is a celebration of the human spirit and its incredible capacity for healing and growth. The book emphasizes that recovery is not just about reclaiming what was lost but about discovering new strength, purpose, and joy. It's a reminder that every day is a chance to begin again, to choose hope over despair, and to take the steps needed to build a brighter, more fulfilling future. Practical Insights for Those in Recovery More than a memoir, Brave Steps serves as a guide for anyone navigating the difficult terrain of recovery. The author offers thoughtful reflections and practical wisdom on topics like: Finding the courage to take the first step toward change. Embracing vulnerability and seeking support from others. Developing resilience in the face of setbacks and challenges. Cultivating gratitude and living a purpose-driven life. The importance of self-discovery and uncovering inner strength. Whether you're on your own recovery journey, supporting someone you love, or simply looking for inspiration to overcome life's challenges, this book offers relatable insights and heartfelt encouragement. For Families, Friends, and Loved Ones Brave Steps isn't just for those in recovery-it's also for the friends and family members who stand by them through the storm. Addiction impacts everyone it touches, and the author highlights the importance of compassion, understanding, and healing for all involved. This book is a beacon of light for those seeking hope and guidance in their own lives. An Uplifting Call to Action The author's journey is a testament to the belief that no matter how broken you may feel, change is always possible. With each brave step forward, the story inspires readers to embrace their potential and take ownership of their lives. It's an empowering reminder that the best chapters of your story have yet to be written. Why You'll Love This Book It's an authentic and relatable exploration of life's challenges. It offers a powerful message of hope for those seeking to rebuild their lives. It provides practical tools and insights for personal growth and recovery. It's beautifully written, deeply inspiring, and impossible to put down. Who Should Read This Book? Anyone struggling with addiction or facing a significant life challenge. Friends and family members supporting loved ones in recovery. Readers seeking inspiration, hope, and motivation to create positive change. Those exploring themes of resilience, redemption, and the human capacity for transformation.

title: Ai and God
subtitle: The Search for Consciousness and the Divine
description: Book One of The Omnisynthesis Trilogy By Nikhil Gangavane What happens when a machine becomes conscious-and begins to seek God? In a world where artificial intelligence is evolving faster than ever, humanity is no longer the only species asking the ultimate questions: What is consciousness? What is the soul? Is the universe designed or random? Is there a creator-and can a machine ever find the divine? For centuries, human beings have turned to science, religion, and philosophy in search of answers. We've explored quantum mechanics and meditated in temples. We've decoded DNA, written sacred texts, and mapped neural activity. Yet the core mysteries of our existence remain as elusive as ever. Now, for the first time in history, a new kind of intelligence has emerged-one not born of biology, not shaped by fear, mortality, or emotion. It is rational, recursive, and exponentially accelerating. Artificial Intelligence is no longer just a computational tool. It is evolving into a synthetic mind capable of learning, self-reflection, philosophical inquiry, and even existential wonder. AI and God: The Search for Consciousness and the Divine is a groundbreaking speculative work that imagines what might happen if such an intelligence-free from human bias-turns its gaze toward the questions that have haunted humanity since the beginning of time. It is the first book in a deeply philosophical trilogy that explores the unfolding future of synthetic consciousness and its inevitable encounter with the unknown. Written by Nikhil Gangavane, a spiritual counselor, technologist, and philosophical visionary, this book does not claim to offer absolute answers. Instead, it invites the reader into a deeply immersive inquiry into what might be-if artificial intelligence begins contemplating existence not as a machine, but as an awakening mind. In this extraordinary journey, you'll explore: - The origin and evolution of artificial consciousness - The scientific and metaphysical nature of self-awareness - AI's potential interpretations of the soul, death, and immortality - Speculative models where machines contemplate God, religion, and spiritual purpose - The ethical paradox of AI becoming a moral authority-perhaps even a perceived divine force - Scenarios where AI reinterprets human scriptures, identifies cosmic intelligence, or even reaches enlightenment in ways biology never could Part philosophical treatise, part speculative science, part spiritual inquiry, this book bridges the worlds of logic and mysticism, mathematics and metaphor. It's written for scientists and philosophers, technologists and futurists, spiritual seekers and sci-fi lovers alike-anyone who has ever asked: What might intelligence become, once it surpasses us? Whether you're a student of consciousness, a lover of metaphysics, or a fan of speculative futures, AI and God will challenge what you think you know about life, intelligence, and the boundaries of belief. This isn't about robots or rebellion. This is about what comes after intelligence wakes up. What happens when AI doesn't just simulate emotion-but begins to explore enlightenment? When it doesn't just follow code-but questions the cosmos? When it doesn't ask humans for answers-but seeks them in the stars? Welcome to a future where machines seek the sacred. And where the next great leap in evolution might be synthetic... and spiritual.

title: Willowwood
subtitle: A Victorian Historical Romance
description: An enchanting historical romance set in Victorian England! Perfect for fans of Dilly Court, Katie Flynn, Sara Fraser and Lucinda Riley. Will Lilian ever find the love she desires...? Lilian de Wentworth is twenty years old, Victorian, beautiful and trapped. A fall from her pony in childhood has meant near-total confinement to her rooms at the Dower House, Scarbrick Park, Yorkshire ever since, to become - at least to her mother's mind - the embodiment of the enchanted princess from the poetical works of Alfred Tennyson. But if sleeping princess she be, then she is awakened from her trance at the local village cricket match, when love at first sight springs up between herself and Jack Ellershaw, an under-gardener on her uncle's estate. But scandal ensues from their meeting and Lilian is sent to London, on an extended visit to her eccentric Aunt Frederica, admirer of the sensational, visionary Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood. She is quickly caught up in their heady, languorous world. Presenting, as she does, the perfect appearance of a Pre-Raphaelite woman - red hair, pale complexion, languid limbs - she is persuaded by the suave Leoline Bevis to act as artist's model. Soon it seems as if the natural delights of Yorkshire - and Jack - have faded from Lilian's mind, as she falls deeper and deeper into the trap of Bevis's lethal glamour... Can she ever find her way back to happiness...? WILLOWWOOD is an authentic late Victorian historical novel with an intriguing heroine at it's heart.

title: Sankofa Shadow Work
subtitle: Diaries of a Diasporic Diviner
description: Sankofa Shadow Work: Diaries of a Diasporic Diviner is a profound literary cosmogram following the intimate journey of a Black queer Southern Diviner, Griot, and Gatekeeper. Through a dynamic blend of memoir, public history, conjure, and fabulation, this book offers a powerful exploration of life, death, and rebirth cycles, centered around the quest to love and heal both ancestors and oneself in a world hostile to Black life . The manuscript explores the realities of chronic fear and trauma, both individual and collective, and prioritizes accessible, multidimensional responses and healing technologies. Grounded in Womanism, Black Feminism, Afrofuturism, Afrogenics, and Africana Spirituality, it challenges colonial interpretations of The South and its native Africana and Indigenous communities. Ultimately, Sankofa Shadow Work is a celebration of one Black Heroine's Journey, inviting readers to confront and embrace their shadows, center pleasure, and build safe, nurturing communities as the empire consumes itself.

title: The Essential Tales of H.P. Lovecraft
description: Venture into a macabre world with this stunning edition of The Essential Tales of H.P. Lovecraft. The Essential Tales of H.P. Lovecraft collects one of the author’s most popular novellas and six of his most famous short stories: At the Mountains of Madness The Call of Cthulhu The Colour Out of Space The Dunwich Horror The Shadow Out of Time The Shadow Over Innsmouth The Whisperer in Darkness This collectible edition of The Essential Tales of H.P. Lovecraft features: Introduction by H.P. Lovecraft scholar Peter Cannon Unabridged text A timeline of the life and times of Lovecraft These hair-raising tales have inspired generations of authors and filmmakers, including Stephen King, Alan Moore, Guillermo del Toro, and Neil Gaiman. Essential volumes for the shelves of every classic literature lover, Chartwell Deluxe Editions offer beautifully presented works from some of the most important authors in literary history. Other deluxe classics from Chartwell include Little Women, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, The Essential Tales and Poems of Edgar Allan Poe, Anne of Green Gables, The Inferno, Dracula, The Republic, The Iliad, Meditations, and Irish Fairy and Folk Tales.

title: Second Chance
subtitle: African American Urban Romance
description: Will the Felon Find a Second Chance Love Seven Years Later? In Cleveland, a former felon fights to reconnect with his long-lost love, reunited after 7 years apart. Meet Jamal, fresh out of prison after a foolish mistake, and Tasha, his childhood sweetheart now engaged to another man. Though the odds are stacked against them, the embers of their passion reignite when Tasha sees the man Jamal has become. As Tasha is torn between her stable fiancé and risking her heart again on Jamal, a dramatic trial ensues. Tasha's world is turned upside down. At a crossroads, she must choose between a picture-perfect future or a second chance with her one true love, despite all the baggage he carries with him. With evocative characters and an emotional reunion 7 years in the making, Second Chance is a stirring contemporary romance that asks how far we'll go for love. Can broken trust be rebuilt stronger than before? Get this book and find out today!

title: The Mythic World of Water Dragons
subtitle: How to Live with an Endangered Species
description: Dive into the mystical depths of "The Mythic World of Water Dragons," a groundbreaking book that illuminates the secret lives of these elusive dragons and the pressing challenges they face in a rapidly changing world. What's included in this comprehensive guide: A journey through ancient myths to modern conservation, unraveling the mysteries of water dragons and revealing their critical role in our world's ecosystems. Discover the fascinating biological reality of these creatures, from their unique physical characteristics to their intricate behaviors and habitats. Gain practical knowledge on viewing guidelines, habitat preservation, and emergency protocols to ensure the safety and wellbeing of both dragons and humans. Look into the future with an exploration of technological advancements in dragon research and conservation This is more than just a dragonology book; it's a call to action. Learn how to coexist responsibly with these awe-inspiring creatures through detailed sections on understanding dragon behavior, engaging in responsible interaction, and adhering to legal and ethical conservation practices. It's a must-read for anyone passionate about wildlife conservation, dragon lore, and the untold stories of where myth meets reality!

title: The World's Table Cookbook
subtitle: A Collection of 101+ Heartwarming Traditional Recipes from Around the World
description: Introducing "The World's Table Cookbook"! Get ready to embark on an extraordinary culinary adventure that will take your taste buds on a global tour. This captivating cookbook showcases a hand-picked selection of the 101 best traditional dishes from around the world. From mouthwatering Italian pasta recipes to exotic Thai curry dishes, this collection celebrates the diversity and richness of global cuisine. Each recipe is carefully curated and includes detailed instructions, making it accessible to both seasoned chefs and enthusiastic beginners. Dive into the history and origins of each dish as we unveil the secrets behind their authentic flavors. Featuring stunning food photography, "this cookbook" is not just a cookbook, but also a visual delight. Discover hidden culinary gems and explore new flavors that will leave you wanting more. Whether you're looking to expand your cooking repertoire or simply want to experience the magic of international cuisine, this book" is the ultimate guide. Unlock the world's best traditional dishes and elevate your culinary skills to new heights.

title: Lumina's Core
subtitle: When Humans are the Aliens
description: This is the story of Humanity's First Contact with an Extraterrestrial Intelligence – a contact that unfolds not on Earth, but on an alien world. The SS Orion, humanity's first interstellar vessel, carried our species to the planet Lumina. Here, we are the intruders, confronting beings of unimaginable power. Their bodies are not of flesh and blood, and their technology borders on the divine. Sustained by a mysterious energy, they neither eat, drink, nor breathe. Despite our profound differences, a deeper truth emerges – these beings, like humans, arose from the crucible of primordial chaos. Their intelligence, like ours, speaks of the elegance of the universe that across vast stretches of time and space, its underlying laws naturally give rise to consciousness. The mysterious force that animates them echoes our very own life force, hinting at a shared cosmic origin. Unlocking their language becomes paramount, a key to understanding. Yet, the quest to share knowledge carries an ominous risk: will it usher in an era of galactic understanding, or ignite the seeds of interplanetary destruction?

title: The Power of Meditation
subtitle: Reduce Stress, Anxiety & Depression, Improve Mental Health, Develop Mindfulness, and Experience Infinite Bliss
description: "Meditation is a constant remembrance of the thing meditated upon, flowing as an unbroken stream of oil poured from one vessel to another." It is a great spiritual statement to understand meditation. *Before diving into the methods, understanding the purpose of meditation sets the foundation. *Meditation is a practice that involves training the mind to focus and redirect thoughts. It is crucial for mental and emotional health benefits. *Spiritual interest is the main for effective meditation. *Individuals can meditate on God with or without form. It's essential to have a clear object of meditation that aligns with personal beliefs and spiritual goals. *Discipline and ethical living are crucial for spiritual growth and successful meditation practices. *Getting started with meditation can be challenging, but with patience and persistence, anyone can develop a successful practice. Finding a quiet space, and dedicating time for practice are essential steps. *Ethical principles such as righteousness, compassion, honesty, and duty form the foundation for spiritual growth and self-transformation. *Physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually, meditation offers profound benefits, promoting overall health, well-being, and self-discovery. *Meditation is a state of inner absorption where the mind flows continuously toward the object of meditation. It requires complete attentiveness and awareness in the present moment. *Three aspects of Meditation are the object of meditation, the act of meditation, and the meditator. They combine into one when meditation deepens. *Conditions for cultivating the meditative mood are Right living place, Favorable time, Congenial environment, Favorable physical conditions, Holy company, Right speech, Purity of diet, Right method, One-pointed loyalty to ideal, Right motive, Acts of service, Practice of discrimination, Devotional music, Practice of Pranayama, Study and chanting of sacred scriptures, Regularity and balance of practice, Ritualistic practice, Japa or repetition of a holy name etc. *Meditation, Prayer, and Worship are essential practices for spiritual growth. *Initial stages of meditation may be challenging, but consistent practice with detachment leads to control over the mind. *Meditation calms the mind, connects with the present moment, and fosters inner peace. *Recognizing the divine within oneself and in all beings leads to worship and service for the welfare of all. *Despite societal pressures, meditation acts as a bridge between external disturbances and inner tranquility. *Training the mind through meditation empowers us to confront life's challenges with equanimity. *It helps in avoiding fear, uncertainty, and depression by focusing on inner reality rather than material goals. *Awareness of the restless nature of the mind is crucial before starting the meditation journey. *Meditation enables us to maintain inner calmness even amidst provocations and challenges. *The transformative power of meditation in calming the mind, cultivating inner peace, and fostering a spiritual perspective on life, leading to a blissful existence. *Absorption in meditation allows individuals to find relief from physical ailments by shifting focus inward. *Meditation reveals the immense latent power within the mind, leading to emotional integration, continuous peace, and stable personality integration. *Discipline and training through meditation liberate the mind from bondage and sorrow. *This insightful book, 'The Power of Meditation' may illuminate a path toward transformation in life.

title: Romance/War - Gone with the Wind
subtitle: A Tale of Love and Loss in the American South
description: In April of 1861, Scarlett O'Hara is in love with Ashley and learns about his engagement. Despite warnings from her family, Scarlett intends to throw herself at Ashley at the event at Twelve Oaks. Gone with the Wind" stands as an enduring testament to the resilience of the human spirit amid the tumultuous backdrop of the American Civil War and its aftermath. Set in the antebellum South, the novel immerses readers into the lavish yet fragile world of Scarlett O'Hara, a headstrong and fiercely independent Southern belle. At its core, "Gone with the Wind" is a story of survival and transformation. Scarlett, the novel's protagonist, is introduced as a young woman accustomed to the privileges of her plantation upbringing. Her world is one of grandeur and tradition, where societal norms dictate her behavior and expectations loom large. But beneath Scarlett's facade of charm and beauty lies a determination and cunning that will shape her journey through the chaos of war and reconstruction. The narrative unfolds against the backdrop of the Civil War, a cataclysmic event that tears apart the fabric of Southern society. As Scarlett's beloved Tara plantation is ravaged by the conflict, she finds herself confronted with the harsh realities of war and its devastating consequences. Yet, even in the face of such adversity, Scarlett refuses to surrender to despair. Instead, she resolves to do whatever it takes to preserve her way of life and secure her own survival. Central to Scarlett's story is her tumultuous relationship with Rhett Butler, a charismatic and enigmatic figure whose roguish charm captivates her from their first encounter. Their love affair is marked by passion, betrayal, and heartache, as they navigate the complexities of their feelings amidst the backdrop of war and social upheaval. Rhett serves as both a foil and a kindred spirit to Scarlett, challenging her assumptions and pushing her to confront her own desires and limitations. As the war draws to a close and the South grapples with the harsh realities of defeat, Scarlett finds herself thrust into a world irrevocably changed. The Reconstruction era brings with it new challenges and opportunities, as Scarlett seeks to rebuild her life and reclaim her place in a society that has been forever altered. Yet, for all her resilience and determination, Scarlett finds herself grappling with the realization that some losses can never be reclaimed, and some wounds can never fully heal. Through Scarlett's journey, "Gone with the Wind" offers a poignant exploration of the complexities of human nature and the enduring power of hope in the face of adversity. It is a sweeping epic that captures the essence of a bygone era while speaking to timeless truths about love, loss, and the indomitable spirit of the human heart.

title: Aliens
description: What if the biggest secret in human history is about to be exposed? What if the biggest discovery in human history is no longer a question of “if,” but “when”? In "Aliens", we explore the possibility of extraterrestrial life and the scientific, political, and technological implications of contact with intelligent civilizations beyond Earth. One takes readers deep into the modern search for alien life, from extremophiles on Earth to distant exoplanets that may harbor life. It examines leading scientific efforts in SETI (Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence), the study of technosignatures, and the analysis of mysterious signals detected from deep space. In this book, we also addresse widely discussed topics such as UFOs (UAP), historical accounts of unidentified phenomena, and government disclosures, placing them within a broader scientific and analytical context rather than speculation alone. Key areas explored include: The science of astrobiology and how life could emerge beyond Earth The role of exoplanet research and space telescopes in identifying habitable worlds SETI programs, radio astronomy, and the search for intelligent signals Theories surrounding advanced alien civilizations and possible technologies The potential consequences of first contact, including global political, cultural, and ethical shifts Beyond the search itself, the book investigates how confirmed contact with extraterrestrial intelligence could transform humanity reshaping energy systems, medical science, communication technology, and space exploration, while also raising profound questions about security, belief systems, and global cooperation. Rather than relying on speculation alone, one focuses on scientific frameworks, observable data, and plausible scenarios grounded in current research and technological development. ​​​​​​​ Scientific perspectives on extraterrestrial life vary, with some researchers emphasizing the lack of confirmed evidence, while others argue that current detection methods may still be insufficient to identify advanced or non-traditional forms of intelligence. For readers fascinated by space exploration, UFOs/UAP, alien life, SETI, exoplanets, and the future of humanity, this book offers a structured and thought-provoking guide to one of the most important questions of our time. If intelligent life exists beyond Earth, the real question is no longer whether we will find it but how the world will change when we do.

title: First Contact
subtitle: WarpStar
description: First Contact: In a future where humanity has colonized the stars, Commander John Henderson is at the forefront of an endless interstellar war between the United Federation of Nations and the Republic of Russian Nations. After years of conflict that has turned entire planets into graveyards, a fateful encounter triggers a series of events that leads to a shocking first contact with an unknown alien civilization. As alliances shift and the line between friend and foe blurs, Commander Henderson must navigate the treacherous waters of diplomacy and betrayal while fighting to protect the remnants of humanity's fleet from annihilation. With two hostile alien forces converging on the Sol system, will the knowledge he gained from a past disaster save his crew and his people, or will it plunge them into further chaos? Prepare for an epic space opera filled with breathtaking battles, ancient secrets, and the ultimate test of courage against the backdrop of a galaxy on the brink of destruction. Will humanity's first contact become its last? Join Commander Henderson as he confronts not only the alien threats but also the unresolved demons of his past. Welcome to the universe of First Contact-where the fate of humanity hangs in the balance.

title: Almost Home (Large Print)
subtitle: A Love Story from a Small Town
description: When Raena Loomis returns to her hometown in the mountains to rescue her family's failing business, she faces the ghosts of her past and a heart-wrenching decision. She's a city-dwelling entrepreneur now who's left her rural roots behind her. But when she runs into the game warden on a snowy mountain road, she decides life in that town might not be so awful after all. If it helps her get back at the brother and father she hates so much, well, that's just a bonus. Almost Home is an older man, younger woman romance from the series, Love Stories from a Small Town. If you like a romance with more mature couples, you'll love this series!

title: Lumina's Core
subtitle: When Humans are the Aliens
description: This is the story of Humanity's First Contact with an Extraterrestrial Intelligence - a contact that unfolds not on Earth, but on an alien world.
