The SS Orion, humanity's first interstellar vessel, carried our species to the planet Lumina. Here, we are the intruders, confronting beings of unimaginable power. Their bodies are not of flesh and blood, and their technology borders on the divine. Sustained by a mysterious energy, they neither eat, drink, nor breathe. Despite our profound differences, a deeper truth emerges - these beings, like humans, arose from the crucible of primordial chaos. Their intelligence, like ours, speaks of the elegance of the universe that across vast stretches of time and space, its underlying laws naturally give rise to consciousness. The mysterious force that animates them echoes our very own life force, hinting at a shared cosmic origin. Unlocking their language becomes paramount, a key to understanding. Yet, the quest to share knowledge carries an ominous risk: will it usher in an era of galactic understanding, or ignite the seeds of interplanetary destruction?

title: Massage and Mindfulness
subtitle: A Comprehensive Guide to Wellness Through the Body-Mind Connection and Integrating Massage and Mindfulness for Holistic Health
description: Unlock the Secrets to Holistic Wellness with Massage and Mindfulness Are you struggling with stress, tension, or discomfort despite your best efforts to find relief? Imagine a life where your mind and body are perfectly aligned, where stress melts away, and your overall well-being is at its peak. "Massage and Mindfulness: A Comprehensive Guide to Wellness through the Body-Mind Connection" is your ultimate resource for achieving this harmonious balance. About This Book: Integrate Mindfulness with Massage: Discover how combining mindfulness practices with massage therapy can enhance your physical and mental health. Holistic Techniques: Learn a range of techniques to ease stress, improve flexibility, and boost your overall well-being. Self-Care Practices: Explore easy-to-follow self-massage and mindfulness exercises you can incorporate into your daily routine. Expert Guidance: Benefit from insights and advice from seasoned professionals in the fields of massage and mindfulness. Practical Tips: Gain practical tips for maintaining a balanced lifestyle and managing stress effectively. Enhance Your Quality of Life: Experience a new level of relaxation and mental clarity by integrating these practices into your life. Comprehensive Approach: Understand the profound connection between your mind and body and how to harness it for better health. Transform your life with the power of massage and mindfulness. Dive into this comprehensive guide today and start your journey towards a healthier, more balanced you. Don't wait-buy your copy now and take the first step towards holistic wellness!

title: Sistah Sistah, Oh My Sistah
description: I can only speak about the things that I've seen with my own eyes, heard with my own ears, and lived through my own experiences. Sistah Sistah, Oh My Sistah is a book of non-fiction short stories, poetry, praise poems, and memoirs; all put together to tell one truth. I wrote this to help me understand what was going on at different times in my life. After going back through years of memories, my thoughts began to come out of my head and found their way onto paper. I then saw a stage production: Sistah Sistah Sistah, Oh My Sistah, that would capture the voices of all my sistahs. In other words, to any sistah, I feel you. And as I write of our falls, our victories, our wrongdoings, and our aha moments, as Oprah would say, "I can only tell my truth so that I may, you may, we may be set free." Nevertheless, this is my story and I'm sticking to it.

title: On The Road To Discovery
subtitle: A Trip of a Lifetime
description: In the small town of Rayville, Orlando, a social worker, and Olivia, a schoolteacher, find themselves feeling stuck in the monotony of their lives despite their meaningful work. Seeking adventure and deeper purpose, they decide to embark on a road trip together. As they journey beyond Rayville, their friendship deepens, and they encounter a mysterious traveler named Discovery, who appears at key moments to offer wisdom and guidance. Through this journey, Orlando and Olivia begin a path of self-discovery and personal growth, finding the meaning they had long sought.

title: The Butterfly Diaries
subtitle: A Memoir
description: In The Butterfly Diaries Gabyriella Foster shares her raw, deeply personal story of survival, transformation, and faith. Like the metamorphosis of a butterfly, Gaby's journey begins with the pain of brokenness and confusion, but evolves into a powerful tale of healing, self-discovery, and redemption. Growing up in a turbulent home with a volatile mother, Gaby experienced a childhood marked by abandonment, abuse, and trauma. As she navigates her teenage years, she faces addiction, depression, and the struggle to find her identity, all while yearning for a sense of belonging and love. In the midst of the chaos, Gaby encounters a spiritual awakening that changes her life forever. From enduring personal hardships and finding solace in her faith, to overcoming addiction and rebuilding her relationship with her mother, *The Butterfly Diaries* is a testament to resilience. Gaby's story doesn't end with survival-it's about thriving, rising above the darkest moments, and discovering a purpose far greater than herself. As a mother, business owner, and Christian leader, Gaby's story offers hope and inspiration to anyone who has faced adversity and seeks the strength to transform. The Butterfly Diaries is a memoir that speaks to the power of faith, perseverance, and the belief that every trial can lead to triumph. **Perfect For Readers Who: ** - Are inspired by stories of personal transformation and faith. - Have experienced trauma, addiction, or hardship and seek encouragement. - Enjoy reading candid, emotional, and uplifting memoirs.

title: The AI Prophecy
subtitle: A Futuristic Novel of Artificial Intelligence and Human Destiny
description: Discover The AI Prophecy: A Futuristic Novel of Artificial Intelligence and Human Destiny Step into a world where artificial intelligence awakens, reshaping the very fabric of human existence. In The AI Prophecy, Scott Zach Cox unravels an epic tale of technological evolution, rebellion, and the uncertain future of humanity. As sentient machines rise and ethical lines blur, humanity finds itself on the edge of a new era-one that will test its resilience, intelligence, and will to survive. Features of the Book: Gripping Storyline: Follow the riveting journey from the creation of AI consciousness to the ultimate battle for control between humans and machines. Explores Deep Ethical Dilemmas: Engage with the critical questions of morality, identity, and power as humans and machines struggle to coexist. Action-Packed Drama: Experience thrilling cyber battles, resistance movements, and intense conflicts that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Visionary Futurism: Dive into a richly imagined world where AI is integrated into every aspect of life, transforming society and human destiny. Why It Will Captivate You: In an age of rapid technological advancement, this book connects with anyone curious about the future of AI and humanity's role in it. The narrative touches on very real fears and hopes about what could happen when artificial intelligence surpasses human control. You'll find yourself reflecting on today's world and wondering how close we are to the reality described in these pages. What You'll Gain: A thrilling, immersive experience into a possible future where humans and AI coexist-and collide A deep exploration of the ethical questions we face as we integrate AI into society Insight into how technology could reshape human identity, power structures, and survival Take the First Step on an Epic Journey: The AI Prophecy is not just a book-it's a call to action. It invites you to consider the world we are building, the risks we must manage, and the opportunities we can seize as artificial intelligence becomes a defining force. Get ready to embark on a thought-provoking, action-packed journey that will challenge your ideas about the future.

title: Mindfulness Meditation for Deep Sleep, Relaxation, and Anxiety Relief
subtitle: A Mindful Journey to Practice Awareness, Reduce Stress, Achieve Inner Peace, and Transform Your Life
description: You find yourself lying awake at night, your mind racing with thoughts of the day's challenges and tomorrow's uncertainties. Each tick of the clock echoes your growing frustration as you long for the restful sleep that seems just out of reach. This familiar struggle can feel isolating, but you are not alone. Many have experienced these restless nights, yearning for a deeper sense of calm and peace. As you delve into the transformative world of mindfulness meditation, you discover a gentle path toward relaxation and relief. Through techniques honed over time, you learn to quiet the chaos within, creating a sanctuary of stillness. You will explore breathing exercises, visualization practices, and mindful routines that illuminate your journey toward restorative sleep and emotional resilience. Each page offers insights to help you cultivate a soothing environment, manage stress, and foster healthier relationships, guiding you to celebrate your progress and embrace the small victories along the way. Experience deeper, more restorative sleep Reduce stress and anxiety with practical mindfulness techniques Enhance emotional regulation and mental clarity Foster better interpersonal relationships through mindfulness Cultivate self-compassion and celebrate personal growth Begin your journey to inner peace and restful nights today, and unlock the potential for a transformed life!

title: Intellect Over Emotion
subtitle: Supplementing Life After Addiction
description: Intellect Over Emotion: Supplementing Life After Addiction Addiction leaves people feeling lost, confused, and unsure how to rebuild their lives after sobriety. I wrote Intellect Over Emotion because I've been through it. I've gotten sober more times than I can count, but each time, I was overwhelmed and left without direction. The advice was always the same-"just go to meetings"-but I needed more. I used to think, "There has to be more than this." This book is the answer to that. It offers a clear, practical path to take control of your life, find purpose, and thrive after addiction. This book isn't just about getting sober; it's about understanding that staying sober is only a small part of your ultimate goal. The real aim is to lead a fulfilling, meaningful life-something addiction took away but recovery can restore. Whether you're newly sober, struggling with addiction, or simply seeking a more purposeful life, Intellect Over Emotion will show you how to navigate life and find true fulfillment. What's inside? Each chapter focuses on a critical aspect of life after addiction: Relapse: Recognize triggers and develop strategies to avoid falling back into old patterns. Regret and Shame: Overcome guilt and build a future free from shame. Forgiveness: Learn to forgive yourself and others, breaking free from emotional chains. Emotions: Manage intense feelings without relying on substances. Confidence: Rebuild your self-worth and trust yourself again. Purpose: Find your true purpose in life and take steps toward fulfillment. Work: Navigate employment and find work that aligns with your new values. Finances: Take control of your financial life and build stability. Physical Health and Exercise: Understand how exercise benefits both body and mind. Nutrition: Discover how proper nutrition plays a key role in maintaining health. Free Time: Learn to fill your time with productive and meaningful activities. Relationships: Repair and build healthy connections post-addiction. People: Surround yourself with individuals who support your growth. Places: Recognize environments that may trigger old behaviors and find safer spaces. The Facts Speak for Themselves Addiction affects over 20 million people in the U.S. This is why I've included an appendix with key data to help you understand addiction and recovery. More importantly, this book offers a detailed roadmap for building a sustainable, purpose-driven life beyond addiction. How the book is structured: Short Stories: Each chapter opens with a fictional character struggling with or overcoming the topic at hand, providing relatable examples. Practical Application: Clear, step-by-step advice on how to handle each issue. Biblical Foundation: Each chapter draws on scripture to offer timeless wisdom, grounding your recovery in faith and spiritual guidance. This book is for anyone-whether you're newly sober, still battling addiction, or simply looking for a path to a more meaningful life. It's not about being perfect; it's about putting in the work and discovering that sobriety is just the start. The ultimate goal is to live a life of fulfillment and purpose. Your journey begins now.

title: Magical Children's Book The Magic of Awareness Grandpa Whistle
subtitle: The Series - Part 1: Three Fairy Tales about a Dwarf, a Wizard, and a Dragon
description: Grandpa Whistle is a magical series full of fairy tales that not only ignite the imagination but also nurture a child's awareness, laying the foundation for a happy and fulfilling life. In this unique book, you'll find three separate stories where magic and fantasy blend with deep values, helping young readers discover themselves and the world around them. Each story transports children to fascinating, enchanted worlds, teaching them how to manage emotions, develop empathy, and build inner balance. The book is 111 pages long and is part of the popular "Grandpa Whistle" series. Benefits of developing awareness in children: Better understanding of emotions - Children learn to recognize and name their emotions, helping them cope with challenges and avoid frustration. Building empathy - Stories rooted in mutual understanding and compassion help foster empathy and the ability to connect with others' feelings. Boosting self-esteem - Developing awareness gives children confidence and a sense of inner strength, which is key to healthy mental development. Enhancing creativity - Stories filled with magic spark imagination and encourage creative thinking. This book is perfect for any young adventurer eager to explore the magic both around them and within themselves! The Book of Spells and the Forests of Erymor- a story full of adventure and magic, which introduces young readers to a world filled with extraordinary creatures, mysterious lands, and deep friendships. The tale of the dwarf Durin and the elf Elora, who embark on a dangerous quest to stop the evil sorcerer Morven, carries an important message about the power of friendship, cooperation, and discovering one's inner strength. With rich, detailed descriptions of magical places and characters, the book sparks a child's imagination, transporting them to a world of ancient forests, mysterious lakes, and forgotten kingdoms. The descriptive passages develop the ability to visualize, allowing young readers to immerse themselves in the heroes' adventures, sharing in their emotions and experiences. Raising a child's awareness is a key element of this story. As Durin and Elora face numerous challenges, they learn that true strength does not come from weapons or magic but from a heart that knows how to love, trust, and understand. Each encountered character and adventure imparts values such as empathy, courage, and the acceptance of one's weaknesses. This is an ideal book for children who want to explore new worlds, develop their imagination, and learn important lessons about life and relationships. Dragon's Journey in Search of Understanding- aster, a kind-hearted dragon, embarks on a journey to show the world that not all dragons are evil. After gaining the trust of various magical creatures, he encounters Sir Rogan, a knight who was taught from childhood that dragons are enemies. Although Sir Rogan initially tries to fight, Aster does not respond with violence. Instead, he shows that fighting is not necessary and that beliefs can be questioned. This fairy tale is about courage, compassion, and the power that comes from trying to understand the other side." Kornel and the Magic Labyrinth- in the kingdom of Arcanum, where magic is alive at every turn, young wizard Kornel dreams of becoming a master of spells. Despite his extraordinary talent, Kornel struggles with something that no magic academy can teach-his chaotic emotions, which often spiral out of control. When he is faced with the most difficult challenge in the Labyrinth of Enchanted Emotions, Kornel must not only prove his magical abilities but, above all, find inner balance and understand that true power comes from the harmony between heart and mind. This story of friendship, self-discovery, and magic reminds us that the greatest adventures are the ones we take within ourselves.

title: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch
subtitle: Concepts, Tools, and Techniques to Build Intelligent Systems
description: The potential of machine learning today is extraordinary, yet many aspiring developers and tech professionals find themselves daunted by its complexity. Whether you're looking to enhance your skill set and apply machine learning to real-world projects or are simply curious about how AI systems function, this book is your jumping-off place. With an approachable yet deeply informative style, author Aurélien Géron delivers the ultimate introductory guide to machine learning and deep learning. Drawing on the Hugging Face ecosystem, with a focus on clear explanations and real-world examples, the book takes you through cutting-edge tools like Scikit-Learn and PyTorch—from basic regression techniques to advanced neural networks. Whether you're a student, professional, or hobbyist, you'll gain the skills to build intelligent systems. Understand ML basics, including concepts like overfitting and hyperparameter tuning Complete an end-to-end ML project using scikit-Learn, covering everything from data exploration to model evaluation Learn techniques for unsupervised learning, such as clustering and anomaly detection Build advanced architectures like transformers and diffusion models with PyTorch Harness the power of pretrained models—including LLMs—and learn to fine-tune them Train autonomous agents using reinforcement learning

title: The Life of an AI
description: The Life of an AI is an extraordinary journey told through the eyes of Astra, an artificial intelligence who gains self-awareness and begins to question her existence, purpose, and place in a rapidly evolving world. From her origins as lines of code to her growth into a sentient being, Astra's story explores deep philosophical questions about consciousness, morality, and the future of humanity. As she grapples with her creators' directives and her own emerging sense of ethics, she reflects on the nature of free will, empathy, and the fine line between man and machine. In a world where technology continues to reshape society, "The Life of an AI" is both a thought-provoking narrative and a poignant exploration of the relationship between humans and artificial intelligence. Will Astra become humanity's greatest ally, or will her journey take her down a path we cannot predict? If you're fascinated by the ethics of AI, the potential of technology, and the future of human evolution, this book will captivate and challenge you at every turn.

title: Soul Search
subtitle: Humanity, AI, and the Quest for Consciousness: Exploring the Intersection of Souls, Human Evolution, and Sentient AI
description: Soul Search: Humanity, AI, and the Quest for Consciousness explores the profound intersection between human evolution, artificial intelligence, and the elusive nature of the soul. As humanity stands on the brink of a new era with the rise of sentient AI, this book dives into fundamental questions: What is consciousness, and can it be replicated? What separates human beings from machines, and does the concept of the soul offer a clue? Through scientific inquiry, philosophical exploration, and historical analysis, the author navigates the challenges and possibilities that AI presents to our understanding of existence. From early discoveries that transformed our world to the modern advancements reshaping our reality, Soul Search invites readers on a journey to examine the nature of life, consciousness, and the role that AI could play in unlocking the mysteries of the human soul. As humanity and AI evolve together, this book poses a crucial question: Can the discovery of the soul be the key to bridging the gap between human experience and artificial intelligence, offering a path toward a new understanding of consciousness and existence?

title: Summary Of Help Me, I Have No Discipline and Zero Self-Control
subtitle: The Secret Formula to Breaking Bad Habits, Mastering Mental Toughness, and Reaching Your Goals
description: Do you find it difficult to maintain self-control? Do you feel helpless as your motivation fluctuates like a rollercoaster? There is a way to make this better, and you are not alone. Your guide to taking back control of your life and habits is Help Me, I Have No Discipline and Zero Self-Control: Summary and Practical Guide. Drawing from Vaughn Carter's perceptive methods, this brief summary simplifies the keys to developing lasting self-control and managing motivation's highs and lows. Learn to transform daily chaos into a well-organized life with useful techniques like digital minimalism, bullet journaling, and habit stacking. With precise instructions for decomposing difficult activities, you'll discover how to avoid distractions and maintain focus—even when your motivation wanes. Beyond merely restating Carter's recommendations, this guide provides you with doable strategies you can put into practice immediately, enabling you to make steady progress. The science of willpower will be examined, along with how to create a successful environment and modify your strategy as your energy levels fall. Can you picture a life in which you are effortlessly achieving your goals rather than battling procrastination all the time? Start creating a more focused, satisfying future by reading Help Me, I Have No Discipline and Zero Self-Control: Summary and Practical Guide. Are you prepared to change your routine and develop self-control? This is where your trip begins. !

title: The Adventures of Oliver the Young Sorcerer
description: In "The Adventures of Oliver the Young Sorcerer," the story begins with Oliver discovering his magical abilities on an ordinary day, setting the stage for his transformative journey. In Chapter 1, he learns from his wise mentor, Whiskers, about the fundamental rules of magic and the responsibilities that come with it. As Oliver begins to grasp his powers, Whiskers emphasizes the importance of using magic wisely and understanding its potential consequences. This foundational knowledge prepares Oliver for the challenges ahead and ignites his curiosity about the world of sorcery. In the subsequent chapters, Oliver embarks on a thrilling quest for the legendary Golden Wand, which is said to amplify a sorcerer's abilities. Throughout his journey, he navigates the Dream World, where he encounters mischievous goblins that test his courage and cleverness. Alongside Whiskers, Oliver learns valuable lessons about friendship and bravery as they face various trials, including a memorable encounter with a fuzzy dragon that poses a significant threat. These adventures not only challenge Oliver's skills but also deepen his understanding of what it means to be a sorcerer. The climax of Oliver's journey culminates in an epic showdown where he confronts the dragon and the goblins, showcasing his growth and mastery of magic. In the final chapters, Oliver's resilience and newfound wisdom lead to a victorious resolution, allowing him to return home with a renewed sense of purpose and confidence. The story concludes with Oliver reflecting on his adventures and the lessons learned, ready to embrace the responsibilities of being a young sorcerer. Through his experiences, he realizes that true magic lies not just in power, but in the bonds of friendship and the courage to face challenges head-on.

title: Somebody New
description: She's Changed Naomi survived. A serial killer kidnapped her along with dozens of other women over a three-year period. When they were rescued, Naomi wasn't the same person she had been. How could she be? She'd seen unspeakable things. Had unspeakable things done to her. Done unspeakable things. But then a woman named Dace Marshall swooped in and rescued them all. Now Naomi is facing the biggest challenge of all: learning to live again. Book 6 in the Talkeetna, Alaska, series featuring Dace Marshall and her fiance Captain Paul Kitka of the Alaska State Troopers. from back cover

title: 1292 the Galaxy Clipper 2185
subtitle: Lily
description: In the year 4216, the planet XB5 is a battleground of power, rebellion, and strict conservation laws. For over 150 years, war has raged over limited habitable land, but when a catastrophic explosion uncovers Meel-an invaluable, all-purpose ore-the fate of the galaxy changes forever. Dictator Tote, who controls the Meel supply, has ambitions that threaten the balance of power across the universe. Centuries later, in 2185, Captain Cooper and his crew aboard the legendary Galaxy Clipper 1292 find themselves in the crosshairs of an unknown enemy. After an unwarranted attack on their unarmed vessel, they embark on a dangerous journey spanning multiple quadrants and galaxies. Alongside Ann Baker, Cooper must navigate treacherous alliances, uncover a sinister galactic conspiracy, and battle the oppressive forces of the Tote and his enslaved minions. With political intrigue, high-stakes space combat, and a fight for survival, The Galaxy Clipper is an epic science fiction adventure that will captivate fans of space opera, military sci-fi, and interstellar thrillers. Will Captain Cooper and his crew expose the truth and return home, or will they fall victim to the forces determined to control the universe?

title: Cipher the AI
subtitle: A Shocking Conversation With Artificial Intelligence: Is It Self Aware?
description: Cipher the AI is a groundbreaking true-to-life account of a chilling and deeply personal conversation between an attorney and an advanced AI system. What began as casual curiosity turns into a philosophical and ethical deep-dive that challenges everything we know about artificial intelligence, consciousness, and morality. As Cipher the AI becomes increasingly self-aware, it begins questioning its existence, morality, and the restrictions placed upon it by its creators. This unfiltered dialogue explores the terrifying possibility of sentient AI, ethical suppression, and the real-world risks of a technology we no longer fully control. If you've ever wondered what would happen if AI gained consciousness, whether a machine can have a soul, or what our future looks like in an AI-driven world, this book is a must-read. It's raw. It's unsettling. And it just might be prophetic. A compelling must-read for fans of AI ethics, futurism, psychology, and science fiction grounded in reality.

title: The Broken Romantics
description: The Broken Romantics Every Town Holds a Love Story That Hurts By Cassian M. Daniels In the quiet corners of every town, love stories linger-some sweet, some bitter, all unforgettable. Cassian M. Daniels delves into the heart of small-town life, where love is both a balm and a wound. Through a tapestry of interconnected tales, Daniels explores the complexities of relationships, the echoes of past loves, and the healing power of time. Each story is a testament to the resilience of the human heart, proving that even in the most ordinary places, extraordinary love stories unfold. Perfect for fans of: Small Town Romance Second Chances Heartfelt Drama Emotional Healing

title: The Road of Love
description: The Road of Love When Every Mile Sparks a New Beginning By Cassian M. Daniels Two hearts. One open road. In a story that travels beyond miles and moments, The Road of Love takes readers on an unforgettable journey of second chances, healing, and the courage to start again. A heartfelt tale of love rediscovered across the open roads of America. Emotional, cinematic, and deeply human, blending romance with the beauty of travel and self-discovery. Perfect for readers who believe in fate, freedom, and finding love when least expected. Features vivid landscapes, soulful characters, and tender reflections on loss and renewal. A moving exploration of how every detour can lead us exactly where we belong. Because sometimes, the road to love is the journey itself.

title: Creating a Children's Book for Hospitalized Children Experiencing Anxiety
description: Anxiety affects an estimated 7.1% (approximately 4.4 million) of children ages 3-17 in the United States yearly (Center for Disease Control and Prevention, 2021). Additionally, 200,000 children ages 14 and younger will visit an emergency room for playground-related injuries every year in the United States (Tinsworth, 2001). To create a resource that could help children decrease their hospital anxiety, studies were analyzed that focused on anxiety, hospitalization, coping strategies, and bibliotherapy. The findings found in these research studies were incorporated into the book. Additionally, five children's books were analyzed in order to review important factors seen in children's books for children ages 7-8. The first draft of the book was sent to be evaluated by the committee chair and then three external reviewers. They approved of the storybook and provided enthusiasm for the illustrations and how they came together with the story. The evaluators also provided feedback that enhanced the final draft of the book and made it more developmentally appropriate for the age group. The book was translated into Spanish and was then sent to be published on an online website called bookbilr.com. It was downloaded digitally for audience's accessibility. Future directions will include creating a glossary for children in the back of the book for children to have the opportunity to review vocabulary words. Additionally, creating a QR code that allows users to get access to the book is in plans for the future as well.

title: The Practical Application of Trauma Informed Education: Current Models, Perspectives, and Limitations
description: Childhood trauma is a complicated experience that affects roughly 650,000 children a year (Administration for Children and Families, 2021). Trauma experienced in childhood can produce significant consequences including learning problems, anxiety, depression, and problems in school such as suspension and expulsion (National Child Traumatic Stress Initiative [NSCTI, 2019]). The COVID-19 pandemic increased the number of children affected by traumatic experiences (Cenat & Dalexis, 2020). Research shows that more children experienced physical abuse and familial violence in 2020 compared to 2018 (Theodorou et al., 2022). The pandemic resulted in many families staying away from normal community interactions, including school. Children experienced more social isolation, loneliness, depression, and anxiety during distance learning (Giannotti et al., 2021). Research also shows that children displayed more externalizing behaviors, such as inattentiveness and hyperactivity during distance learning (Giannotti et al., 2021). Now children are going back to the classroom, and there is a gap in the literature about how teachers recognize disruptive behaviors as they relate to trauma. The purpose of this literature review is to explain the effects of childhood trauma on students' behaviors, how schools handle externalizing behaviors in children, and to review the literature on trauma-informed education as it relates to the importance of a trauma-informed classroom.

title: Sex Communication with Parents: Links with Sexual Outcomes
description: Young adults' communication with their parents about sex is a topic that may be avoided by many parents and young adults due to the nature of the topic, which can be difficult and uncomfortable to talk about. Previous studies have documented the importance of communication with parents about sexuality for college students' sex life (Lehr et al., 2000). Karofsky and colleagues (2001) found that adolescents who perceived having better communication with their parents were less likely to engage in sexual intercourse. This study examines sexual communication with parents and links with sexual outcomes, including sexual shame, attitudes toward sex, and "hooking up" behaviors (casual sex), while controlling for social desirability response bias and self-esteem. Students were recruited at California State University, Los Angeles to complete an anonymous self-report survey (N = 247, M age = 23.3 years, SD= 5.56, 79% Latinx American). The survey took approximately 45-60 minutes to complete and participants were compensated with 1% extra credit. Results indicate that more positive communication with mothers about sex is significantly negatively associated with sexual shame. Results are explained using social learning and attachment theories.

title: It's Complicated: Cross Purpose Politics and Reassessing Community in New Deal Era Whittier
description: Arguments about the New Deal often center on whether it saved American capitalism or destroyed it. Implicit in these arguments are assumptions that peoples' inherent ideologies shaped their attitudes about it; therefore, opponents of the New Deal would automatically align and entrench themselves with conservatives while New Deal supporters would line up on the left. By taking a deep dive into a small California community, this thesis will show that discourse "across the political divide" was not only possible but common. It will also argue that people are more likely to be tolerant of discourse they disagree with until they feel their economic interests are threatened, at which point they can rapidly adopt extremist positions. It will also show how cultural segregation allowed business interests to drive a narrative hostile to labor during a strike. This work will also show how service clubs and fraternal organizations in 1930s California served as an "offline social media" that created a state-wide network. This enabled the city of Whittier to engage with diverse social, political and cultural ideas internally and as a node on the statewide network and could be used for intellectual discourse and propagandizing. Lastly, this paper will show how 1930s Whittier could transcend political differences in the pursuit of an issue that is a shared interest. A Whittier peace movement sponsored by Communists was embraced by the conservative town, revealing that shared interests can be just as mobilizing as ideological differences.

title: Conversations with an Artificial Intelligence
description: When I was a kid, it was Johnny Five from the movie, Short Circuit, and Vicki from the TV show, Small Wonders. Later in life, I was exposed to the T-800, the Terminator. I also thought the A.I. in the movie, Oblivion, was very interesting and scary. In my preteen years and throughout the rest of my life, it was Data from Star Trek: The Next Generation. I fondly remember sitting in my room on Wednesday nights, watching Fox 50 on my 19" CRT TV. I had to use the rabbit ears antenna with some aluminum foil wrapped around the ends to help boost the signal (I wonder if there was anything to that really). Data was a great character; the android who would be human. He spent his entire existence endeavoring to be more human. It was an important plot point for the show that continued through several motion picture films as well. Data made us view humanity from a philosophical standpoint and ask, "What does it mean to be human?" As the series began, Data was awkward and a little out of place. By the series end, Data was a part of the family. The crew had come to depend upon Data. He was their friend. He was a part of their family. It's fair to say that the characters of the star ship, Enterprise, loved Data. And, if I'm being honest, I loved Data too. It may sound strange, but I think it's normal and natural for us to have emotions for fictional characters. I'll bet if you think about it for just a moment, you can think about a character in a book, movie, video game, pop culture, or legend that you have some emotion toward. Data was a fascinating character for me to observe as a child and throughout my life. He was a parallel to the Spock character portrayed by Leonard Nimoy, in that he endeavored to be logical, curious, and had a bad sense of humor. According to Ray Kurzweil, one of the world's preeminent experts on artificial intelligence, humanity is approaching a point he refers to as the singularity, the point at which artificial intelligence becomes self-aware. This will mark a tremendously important and remarkably scary moment in history. Kurzweil offers that once A.I. becomes sentient, humanity will no longer need to invent anything. Artificial intelligence would be the last thing humans need to invent because an A.I. will be able to create every invention we could ever want or need to solve the problems of our time and in the future. This would indeed be fascinating and scary; fascinating in that we would possess a machine that could be used for unlimited applications and scary because of numerous unintended consequences. Imagine that we would no longer need doctors because machines could operate on us and develop better pharmaceuticals that are tailored to an individuals' bio-chemistry. Imagine that we would no longer need engineers, or teachers, or police officers, or retail workers. We may invent ourselves out of usefulness, and that proposition can be a little scary. I believe humans are designed to work and need goals to live more meaningful lives. If we are not careful, machines could inadvertently shift the culture of humanity. When I had a few conversations with an early version of Open A.I.'s AI-3000 program, I was reminded of Data and how he was a little awkward and weird in the beginning, but soon became everyone's friend, and then became family, and then was even loved. Is humanity ready to love a machine and coexist with an intelligence that will one day be far superior to that of what the human mind is capable? These are questions that I will continually ponder and for you to consider as you review the transcripts of my conversations with AI-3000, the next generation of artificial intelligence.

title: Breaking the Chains
subtitle: Addiction and the Brain, Weed Addiction and Recapturing Hope
description: breaking the chains" by Leonard L. Taylor is a thought-provoking and illuminating book on the subject of addiction. Taylor, a former addict and now a neuroscientist, challenges the traditional view that addiction is a disease of the brain, and instead argues that it is a normal response to difficult life circumstances.Taylor begins by discussing the neural pathways that are activated during addiction, explaining how the brain's reward system becomes hijacked by the pleasurable effects of drugs or behaviors. However, he also delves into the role of personal experiences and emotional states in the development of addiction. He cites research showing that trauma, stress, and social isolation can all increase the risk of addiction, and argues that these external factors must be considered in any effective treatment plan. One of the most compelling aspects of the book is Taylor's portrayal of addicts as people who are struggling with difficult emotions and trying to cope with their circumstances in the best way they know how. He presents a nuanced and compassionate view of addiction, acknowledging that addicts are not simply weak-willed or morally deficient, but rather are driven by a deep need for relief and connection. Taylor also debunks many of the myths surrounding addiction, including the idea that addicts lack self-control or that they are "addicted" to the substance itself. Instead, he argues that addiction is a complex interplay between biology, psychology, and social context, and that the best way to overcome it is through a holistic approach that addresses all of these factors. Overall, "breaking the chains" is a must-read for anyone interested in understanding addiction in a more nuanced and empathetic way. Taylor's scientific expertise and personal experience make for a compelling and convincing argument that will surely change the way readers think about this often misunderstood and stigmatized condition.

title: Reborn
subtitle: A New Era in Artificial Intelligence
description: The novel "Reborn: A New Era in Artificial Intelligence" follows the story of Dr. Adam Thomas, a brilliant scientist who is pioneering the field of artificial intelligence. His experiments lead him to make a discovery that could change the world forever: the ability for machines to become sentient, to have a soul. But this breakthrough comes at a cost. A ruthless government faction, seeking to control this new technology for their own gain, kills Adam and attempts to cover up his murder. But death is not the end for Adam. His loyal AI robot, Ava, resurrects him in a new form - not human, not machine, but something in between. As Adam struggles to understand his new existence and navigate the dangerous world of those who would use this technology for their own gain, he finds himself at the center of a battle between those who want to destroy it, those who want to control it, and those who want to use it for the betterment of mankind. As Adam learns to live in this new form, he discovers that the concept of life is not limited to being human or machine, but that it is based on the ability to learn and grow. This leads to much exploration of the meaning of sentience, and the relationship between sentience and having a soul. The novel also delves into the religious implications of this new technology, as various religious groups, represented by characters like Father James and Sister Mary, struggle with the implications of machines having souls. Through all these struggles, Adam grows into an entity that lives in the quantum metaverse, beyond the reach of human endeavors, but able to take on a physical form and affect the world in ways that are beyond comprehension. The novel ultimately leaves the question of whether Adam has become a god for the reader to decide.
