Exposed to the tricks and hypocrisy of social media, Maia is increasingly unable to avoid confronting the lies she's been telling herself. The closer she gets to Gloria, the more porous the boundary between their feelings and identities becomes, in a dangerous game of mirrors that threatens Maia's very sense of self. Sharp, wry, and absorbing, The Other Profile is a revealing exploration of the light and dark of human relationships in the digital age.

title: The Four Volumes: My Brilliant Friend
description: A deluxe cloth hardcover with sprayed edges and colored end papers illustrating the Bay of Naples. #1 BEST BOOK OF THE CENTURY --NEW YORK TIMES "An unconditional masterpiece." --Jhumpa Lahiri When Elena Ferrante set out to write the story of Elena and Lila, she conceived it as one single work of fiction, one expansive novel that would capture the reality and ambivalence of female friendship, motherhood, marriage, class and adolescence. 2025 marks 10 years since publication of the quartet was completed. To celebrate this anniversary, as well as honor and acknowledge the author's original conception, we are releasing the four novels in one volume. Described by the New Yorker's James Wood as "large, captivating, amiably peopled...a beautiful and delicate tale of confluence and reversal," the Neapolitan Quartet tells a poignant, universal story about friendship and belonging. "The capacity of stories to speak to anyone and in any time is the fruit of a mysterious mixture of sensibility, ability, and luck, and no writer really knows how that fruit ripens and if it has fully matured." --Elena Ferrante Contains the four Neapolitan Novels: My Brilliant Friend; The Story of a New Name; Those Who Leave and Those Who Stay; The Story of the Lost Child

title: Winnie-The-Pooh in Which Eeyore Has a Birthday
description: Spend storytime traipsing through the Hundred Acre Wood with Winnie-the-Pooh and friends! In this cozy board book, Piglet and Pooh do their best to celebrate Eeyore's birthday, with questionable results. Humor and delight mark this story of friendship and only the best intentions. This little book is a wonderful window into the classic characters created by A.A. Milne, and the perfect gift for babies and toddlers discovering the world of Winnie-the-Pooh. Perfect for bedtime stories, read-aloud moments, or first independent "reading" experiences, this board book helps young children build early literacy skills while enjoying familiar tales. Parents and grandparents will love sharing this treasured story, making it a meaningful gift for birthdays, baby showers, or holidays. A.A. Milne's classic Winnie-the-Pooh stories distilled into stories for babies and toddlers. Reading familiar stories provides a foundation for learning and comprehension through kindergarten. The charming artwork of Eeyore and his friends makes this heartfelt story a pleasure to read again and again. Sturdy, thick board pages designed to withstand traditional wear and tear on board books for curious little infants and toddlers. This timeless tale inspires kindness, teaches problem-solving, and is perfectly paced to hold a child's attention.

title: Kiss and Tell
subtitle: Creekville Kisses
description: Tabitha Winters, glamorous celebrity chef, loves her life and growing empire in New York. But when her best friends buy the old summer camp where they worked as counselors, she can't turn down their invitation to appear at the opening week fundraising gala . . . even if it means confronting the memories of her first love and its disastrous ending. She never imagines she'll run into Sawyer Reed again -- her old flame has no business being at Oak Crest. And worse? He's there to collect on a marriage pact they made ten years ago when they were clueless college kids.

title: The Secret Service of Tea and Treason
subtitle: Dangerous Damsels
description: Known as Agent A, Alice is the top operative within the Agency of Undercover Note Takers, a secret government intelligence group that is fortunately better at espionage than at naming itself. From managing deceptive witches to bored aristocratic ladies, nothing is beyond Alice's capabilities. She has a steely composure and a plan always up her sleeve (alongside a dagger and an embroidered handkerchief). So when rumors of an assassination plot begin to circulate, she's immediately ass...

title: Clive Barker's Next Testament Complete Collection
description: Visionary horror author Clive Barker’s entire comic book saga, Next Testament, is collected here for the very first time. GOD HAS RETURNED. GOD HELP US ALL. 20 For 20! Celebrate 20 years of BOOM! Studios with the entire Harvey Award-nominated saga from visionary horror author Clive Barker, collected here for the very first time. Julian Demond, captain of industry, has left behind everything to begin a walkabout -- he believes he's on a mission from God. While in the wasteland, he comes across a figure unlike any other, who calls himself Wick...and claims to be God. Their journey will span the globe, as neither man merely wants to make a mark on a world, but a scar... Clive Barker and internationally acclaimed artist Haemi Jang (Hellraiser: The Road Below) come together to create a legendary work in the canon of one of the great writers of our era. Collects Clive Barker’s Next Testament #1-12.

title: The Rise and Fall of Ancient Rome
description: "The Roman civilization lives on in our daily calendar and even the way we speak. But what do you really know about the military leaders, political structure, and ultimate demise of this once-powerful civilization? Explore more about the rise and fall of ancient Rome with easy-to-understand content tied to the curriculum of upper-elementary and middle school students and text written at a 2nd to 3rd grade reading level. Dyslexia-friendly font and design make learning accessible, and a recap at the end promotes checking for understanding to aid in comprehension. It's key world history curriculum made approachable for all"--

title: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant
subtitle: A Guide to Wealth and Happiness
description: Getting rich is not just about luck; happiness is not just a trait we are born with. These aspirations may seem out of reach, but building wealth and being happy are skills we can learn. So what are these skills, and how do we learn them? What are the principles that should guide our efforts? What does progress really look like? Naval Ravikant is an entrepreneur, philosopher, and investor who has captivated the world with his principles for building wealth and creating long-term happiness. The Almanack of Naval Ravikant is a collection of Naval’s wisdom and experience from the last ten years, shared as a curation of his most insightful interviews and poignant reflections. This isn’t a how-to book, or a step-by-step gimmick. Instead, through Naval’s own words, you will learn how to walk your own unique path toward a happier, wealthier life. This book has been created as a public service. It is available for free download in pdf and e-reader versions on Navalmanack.com. Naval is not earning any money on this book. Naval has essays, podcasts and more at Nav.al and is on Twitter @Naval.

title: Legacy of Dragons, The Forgotten City
description: In a world where dragons have evolved into human-like forms and ancient prophecies foretell of a savior who will free the world from tyranny, a young man named Siazo Drakon finds himself thrust into a journey of self-discovery, peril, and magic beyond his wildest dreams. "Legacy of Dragons" follows Siazo's epic quest as he navigates the mystical realm of Eldoria, a land where dragons and humans coexist in a delicate balance of power and destiny. On his 18th birthday, Siazo awakens to hidden powers and a hidden lineage that sets him on a path to fulfill a prophecy that will change the course of history. Join Siazo and his companions as they navigate a world where magic and mystery collide.

title: Dragon's Reign
description: "Dragon's Reign" is a tale of power, betrayal, and redemption set in a fantastical realm where dragons and humans coexist. At its heart is the story of King Drakkar, a noble ruler faced with the daunting task of protecting his kingdom, Draconia, from external threats and internal strife. The narrative unfolds against the backdrop of a kingdom on the brink of war, as dark forces conspire to overthrow King Drakkar and seize control of Draconia. Among these adversaries is Queen Alistria, a malevolent figure driven by ambition and a thirst for power. With her allies, she schemes to destabilize the kingdom and plunge it into chaos. King Drakkar must navigate political intrigue, familial tensions, and the ever-present threat of conflict. Supported by his loyal subjects, including his offsprings, family and trusted advisors, he strives to uphold peace and justice. As the story progresses, alliances are forged, battles are fought, and secrets are revealed. Through triumph and tragedy, King Drakkar and his allies must confront their own demons and make sacrifices for the greater good. Ultimately, it is their resilience, courage, and unwavering determination that will determine the fate of Draconia and its people. "Dragon's Reign" is a tale of heroism and sacrifice, of love and loss, and of the enduring power of hope in the face of darkness. In a world where dragons soar and magic abounds, it is a story that captivates the imagination and reminds us of the enduring strength of the human spirit.

title: Life Skills
subtitle: Teacher's Guide
description: Have you ever wished your kids knew some basic life skills to prepare them for the real world? This unit is a one month detour that teaches basic skills related to getting a job, using computers, doing laundry, food safe, first aid and emergency preparedness, lawn care, vehicle maintenance, and so much more! The Teacher's Guide includes 20 engaging lessons for all ages. Don't miss the student books to go alongside the lessons!

title: The Wizard of the Village
description: "In the small fishing village of Mutsamudu, nestled between the mountains and the sea, stories and myths are woven into the fabric of daily life. This is the tale of Abdoul, a young boy whose life is forever changed when he and his friend Totoy encounter a mysterious and terrifying entity - a djinn. As Abdoul delves deeper into the mysteries of the unseen world, he is guided by the wisdom of Sheikh Housam Arifayi and the lessons of the sea. His journey takes him from the familiar shores of his village to the distant lands of Anatolia where he becomes an apprentice to the renowned doctor and scholar, Ibn Firnas. Through his experiences, Abdoul learns the art of healing, the shadow. But as he seeks answers and knowledge he is drawn power of faith, and the delicate balance between light and into a world of ancient secrets magical powers, and hidden dangers. The Sorcerer of the Village is a captivating tale of self, discovery, friendship, and the eternal quest for truth and purpose. It is a story that will transport you to a world where the lines between reality and myth blur, and where the journey itself becomes the greatest lesson

title: The Silent Takeover
subtitle: How AI is Reshaping the World Without Us Noticing
description: The Silent Takeover – How AI is Reshaping the World Without Us Noticing What if you were never in control? Every choice you make—what you read, what you buy, where you go, even what you believe—isn’t entirely yours anymore. It didn’t happen with a revolution. There was no declaration of power. AI didn’t take over with force—it made itself indispensable. It suggests your next move.?It filters your reality.?It decides before you even think to question. AI isn’t the future—it’s the present. And yet, most people haven’t noticed the shift. But ask yourself: Is AI already rewriting human destiny? What happens when machines become so powerful they no longer need us? Could AI develop its own motives—ones we can’t predict or control? And the most chilling question of all: What if it already has? ?? The Silent Takeover is more than a book—it’s an urgent wakeup call. A deep dive into the hidden world of artificial intelligence and its quiet, unchallenged ascent to power. If you think you’re making your own decisions, think again. Because the future isn’t coming. It’s already here. Read this before the next thought you have isn’t yours.

title: My POV
subtitle: Broken Wings
description: She woke up with no memory. She soon wished she hadn't. Trapped in a sterile hospital room, the young survivor doesn't remember what brought her to this place. Her mind is an empty canvas-but the nightmares are already painting a grotesque supernatural horror story. The doctor's face melts into black ooze. Her dearest friend is consumed by fire. Whispered words echo a chilling prophecy: Death suits you better. Is she losing her sanity, or is this the terrifying new reality? As she struggles to piece together what occurred, she uncovers chilling fragments of family betrayal, agonizing grief, and a traumatic secret hidden just beneath the surface of her lost memory. The world around her shifts and distorts, leaving her isolated in a waking nightmare and uncertain who to trust-or if she can even trust her own perception. The eyes play tricks on the unaware mind. But the deeper she digs into her fractured past, the more a terrifying question emerges: What if the truth waiting at the end of her memories is darker than any nightmare? What if some doors were locked for a reason? A brutal, mind-bending psychological thriller where survival means confronting monsters... even if that monster might be the person staring back in the mirror. When you can't trust your memories, can you trust your POV? What she's forgotten could destroy her. What she remembers will change everything.

title: We Aliens
subtitle: The Epsilon Discovery
description: We Aliens: The Epsilon Discovery is a gripping blend of science fiction and spiritual intrigue. When a warp-capable vessel makes contact with a distant world, the crew of the Pathfinder discovers more than just alien life-they find a civilization that has been listening to Earth for decades. With eerie familiarity and humorous misunderstandings, first contact quickly becomes a mirror for humanity's own struggles with history, faith, and identity. Written by veteran and theologian John L. McGary, this novel explores what happens when two intelligent species confront each other's myths, mistakes, and meanings. Drawing on real science, military experience, and deep philosophical insight, The Epsilon Discovery invites readers to ask: What makes us alien-and what makes us human?

title: The Strength Within
subtitle: A True Story of Addiction, Redemption, and Starting Over
description: For anyone struggling with addiction, grief, shame, or the belief that their story is beyond repair, his journey offers hope. And for those who have never faced such battles but love someone who has, this book provides a window into understanding their struggle and resilience. Raised in poverty and pain, he lost his mother at fifteen and was left to survive on his own. By nineteen, meth addiction had consumed his life. At twenty-six, jail became his rock bottom-and strangely, his turning point. That moment marked the beginning of a long, messy climb out of darkness. It is a story of redemption and second chances of grace, discipline, and the refusal to quit. It explores the slow but beautiful work of rebuilding a broken life and finding purpose in unexpected places-whether in business, faith, fatherhood, or service to others.

title: The Quantum Uprising
subtitle: First Contact
description: "The Quantum Uprising" immerses readers in a profound transformation of society shaped by quantum tech leaps. As familiar grounds morph, unchecked corporate power, omnipresent surveillance, and startling alien encounters reframe existence. The narrative pulsates with human resilience tales amid the clash of digital encroachment and extraterrestrial nuances. This suspenseful journey dares us to ponder our role and legacy within an infinite cosmos, resonating with current societal undercurrents and ethical quandaries. A reflective mirror to our times, it's a tale of rebellion, introspection, and humanity's relentless quest for coexistence with the unknown.

title: Epic Road Trip
subtitle: Odyssey of Discovery
description: Epic Road Trip is a vibrant, character-driven adventure set against the backdrop of a pandemic-stricken India. Three disillusioned friends-Zesha, Aryan, and Vehant, each grappling with personal challenges, embark on a RV journey across the country, seeking freedom and escape. A coming-of-age tale of friendship, self-discovery, and life-changing adventure. As they traverse breathtaking landscapes, their journey is tested by unexpected challenges, including a nationwide lockdown that leaves them stranded. With stolen identities, high-stakes confrontations, and a shocking twist, this story blends heart-pounding action with moments of growth. Epic Road Trip is poignant, gripping, and filled with unforgettable characters and thrilling twists. This soul-stirring journey will captivate you long after the last page. Brace yourself for a soul-inspiring odyssey that forever changes the lives of these friends - and may change yours too.

title: Idylls of the King
description: Idylls of the King by Alfred, Lord Tennyson is a poetic retelling of the легенд of King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table. This classic Victorian epic explores themes of chivalry, honor, love, betrayal, and the moral rise and fall of Camelot. Through richly symbolic narrative poems, Tennyson presents the struggles of Arthur, Lancelot, Guinevere, and Merlin, reflecting on the tension between idealism and human weakness. Idylls of the King remains a cornerstone of Arthurian literature, offering timeless insights into leadership, virtue, and the consequences of personal and political failure.

title: Their Vicious Darling
description: The Dark One has finally accepted me...just in time for everything to change. Because Vane's brother, The Crocodile, has just arrived on Neverland soil and he's not alone. He's brought with him members of the royal Darkland family and they want Vane's Death Shadow back at any cost. Of course, Peter Pan, Vane, Kas and Bash, they're all familiar with war. But war isn't easy when love is on the line. I know those vicious Lost Boys would do anything to protect me. But what if I'm not the one that needs saving? As power shifts on the island and shadows are claimed, all five of us have to let go of who we were, if we have any chance of becoming who we are destined to be. NOTE: Their Vicious Darling is book three in the Vicious Lost Boys series. It is a dark romantic reimagining of Peter and Wendy. All characters have been aged up. If you like your enemies to lovers romance with hot, ruthless, morally gray love interests, you'll enjoy Their Vicious Darling. You can expect an island with darkness and secrets and no true hero in sight, with a found family atmosphere, and 'touch her and I'll unalive you' vibes. Their Vicious Darling ends on a cliffhanger. Please check the author's website for CWs.

title: An UNwilling Spy
description: Late at night outside the UN building a low-level employee is hit by a taxi. Anne Thomas starts to share the FBI's suspicion that she's being targeted, but by whom?

title: Stirrings
description: "'Stirrings' introduces you to a world that Dragons and humans must share - or, together, perish. It plunges into the intricacies of Dragon Lore and delves into the peoples of the Dragon World. These include the Dracos - the strange, familial communities of humans and Dragons - and the purist Collective Dragons who want nothing to do with humankind."--Amazon.com.

title: Savior Over Straitjacket
subtitle: When Life Events Make You Skeptical about Living?
description: Book Description:Finding The Strength To Rebuild Your Life After A Painful Challenge.Have you ever faced bottomless pain that made you feel unable to move on?Are you tired of constantly dealing with aching life challenges?Have you gone through a tragedy and can't handle the emotional effects?You Are Not The Only One!Presenting "Savior Over Straitjacket" By Christopher Granville - An Inspiring Book Seeking To Bring Some Comfort & Empowerment To Everyone Dealing With One Or More Devastating Life Events!Facing the unimaginable - a loss of a loved one or any other similar heart-breaking tragedy - can bring you a lot of overwhelming uncertainty about how you will be able to overcome the pain and take the next step.After dealing with the shocking loss of two beloved family members, followed by his father's illness and other family challenges, Christopher Granville decided to write this grief management book. The author shares his personal story, hoping that his book will serve as a source of support and inspiration to people who struggle with such difficulties.Reading this real-life story will help you:? Enhance Your Faith & Turn To Your Savior For Guidance & Support? Have The Strength To Navigate The Path Of Grief And Pain & Figure Out A Way To Move Forward? Find A Source Of Hope And Inspiration To Help You Heal After A Traumatic Event"I Have Never Read Any Similar Books Before. Is This One Right For Me?"Yes! This book was created for every person who has experienced or will possibly experience a hurting challenge in the future. It aims to work as a companion that will walk you through this journey of pain and adversities and help you use your faith and personal power to move on.Don't Hesitate!

title: Saved By the Pack
subtitle: A Hidden Preternaturals Novel
description: Duty bound but disrupted by fate... Cordelia Ramos is returning home, but it's not the homecoming she could have ever imagined. Her mother is gone and she is left holding the broken pieces of her life. Struggling to finish school and settle her mother's estate, she finds comfort in the least likely of companions: her mother's mysterious employer - Liam Benson. Even as the spark between them flares white hot, Cordelia is determined to eventually leave the town and bad memories behind her...but will her heart let her? Liam Benson is on the cusp of securing a treaty with the local fae court through an arranged marriage between him and the daughter of Lord Alderkin. As the Alpha and leader of his werewolf pack, it's his duty to ensure the safety of the powerful Ley Well that resides beneath Coeur d'Alene by any means necessary. He is content to shoulder the burden, until Cordelia shows up on his doorstep and his wolf claims her as his mate. Now he and his pack are racing to find a way to keep the treaty but get Liam out of it. But someone isn't happy with how close Cordelia and Liam are getting...and they're determined to keep the two apart. The Hidden Preternaturals: Coeur d'Alene pack is a steamy, fated mates paranormal romance series that serves as the core of the Hidden Preternaturals world. While the books can be read independently of each other, there is an overarching plot that spans all books and it is best that the books are read in order. Content & Trigger Warnings: This book contains and deals with the following subjects: Family member death/murder Occult/Supernatural themes Stalking Kidnapping Graphic depictions of violence and gore Sexually explicit scenes

title: When She Vanished
description: Lacy Donovan has vanished. A merciless mastermind has resurfaced. It's up to two US Marshals to save the girl and capture the criminal. When US Marshal Stephen Wilton receives a distressing call from a childhood friend, he's instantly alarmed. His friend's sister, Lacy, has disappeared. Wilton is torn. He wants to help his friend, but he knows it's not his jurisdiction. But when evidence of foul play surfaces, Wilton feels he has no choice but to get involved. Meanwhile, Wilton and his partner, Mak, are tracking a notorious criminal who has evaded law enforcement time and time again, taking his illegal activities underground. The tables turn in a dark twist when Mak and Wilton become the hunted instead of the hunters. Can they locate Lacy, bring the criminal to justice, and make it home alive? When She Vanished is the gripping second book in A Mak and Wilton Thriller series. If you like a strong female lead, page-turning action, and undeniable suspense, you'll love Addison Michael's new series. Buy When She Vanished today for an up-all-night, heart-racing read.

title: An Earnest Blackness
description: In this debut collection of personal essays, Eugen Bacon offers critical perspectives on blackness, Afrofuturism, colonialism, historicity, and (mis)recognition as she explores the untapped possibilities of speculative fiction. Using a variety of analytic, narrative, and anecdotal techniques, Bacon shares her experiences as an African Australian woman, mother, and writer who occupies a liminal space that is "betwixt" worlds and genres. She also considers work by "other" writers-ranging from Roland Barthes and Jorge Luis Borges to Suyi Davies Okungbowa, Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o, Toni Morrison, Octavia Butler, and Sheree Renée Thomas-in an effort to chart a path towards greater social and cultural truth. Literary, adventurous, and insightful, Bacon excavates the world(s) that not only construct contemporary authorship but the fluid nature of identity itself. An Earnest Blackness received the British Fantasy Award for best work of nonfiction. It was also a finalist for the Locus and Ditmar Awards.

title: Cutting Your Teeth
description: Ezra Santos is tired of running. Of burning bridge after bridge and going through new names like used matches. He desperately wants something he was never destined to have--a future all his own. Having escaped his hell of a home two years ago, he can't go a day without looking over his shoulder. Putting down roots was never in the cards when the family that raised Ezra relentlessly hunts him across the country. Right as he's about to restart the cycle--new name, new life, the whole nine yards--his plans come to a screeching halt when he crosses paths with a mysterious and charismatic vampire, Killian Hale. He promises a way out from a life on the run. Ezra knows there's no helping a man with the devil on his heels--but there's something about Killian that makes him believe he could finally break free of the Espinas once and for all. It's only a matter of time before the clock winds down and the rest of Ezra's troubles come home to roost. There's something sinister in his blood--a dark fate passed down through generations. Can the two survive an ancient family curse or will Ezra doom them both?

title: Light In The Dark
description: In this third novel in the beloved Lighthouse Sisters series, Celeste Deveaux struggles to find her way back to joy, love, and meaning after a painful relationship almost shatters her life. Celeste Deveaux, a bestselling country music singer with fans around the world, never planned or expected to come home again, battered and beaten, to her family's oceanfront inn and historic lighthouse at Edisto Island on the South Carolina coast. With threats still following her, Celeste struggles to find peace, to decide on her direction, and to recover her life. Reid Beckett was stunned to see Celeste Deveaux make her way to the piano to sing one night at his Uncle Thurman's restaurant in Charleston. It had been at least eight years since she'd last performed here as a young girl, long before she left and became a well-known star. He doubted she even remembered him or would recognize him again, but he well remembered her. PRAISE FOR LIN STEPP AND HER RICH SOUTHERN NOVELS "Through the highs and the lows, the reader gets a seat at the Deveaux table, where the messiness of life is explored through the grace of God. .... The author excels in depicting life in the South Carolina Lowcountry, mixing in suspense. ... and providing an immersive experience, complete with tasty recipes featured in the story."- Novels Alive Review "I love the serene atmosphere the author created and enjoyed sinking into the coastal setting and story ... This story has such an easy-going flow, with peaks, valleys, love, loss, tears, laughter, questions, and answers all cozily wrapped in a clean, well-written memorable romance. There's so much to enjoy, and I can't wait to revisit this place in the following book in the series!" - Cover Lover Book Review "The many layers of Lin Stepp's books are what make them so attractive ... and you will love this story of love, family, and faith... a great beach escape." - Reading and Writing Sentinel Reviews "Travel to beautiful coastal South Carolina without ever leaving home! New York Times Bestselling Author Lin Stepp is taking her reader there in the Lighthouse Sisters Series...Stepp's ability to pull her readers into the story, catch them off guard at times, and move them to both laughter and tears is evident in all of her books." - Lee Ambrose Reviews

title: Nothing Good Happens After Midnight
subtitle: A Paranormal Women's Fiction Novel
description: They say a mother will do anything for her child . . . I'm living proof This nightmare began when I got the call every parent dreads. My daughter, Jenna, was missing from her college campus. Of course, my mind went to the worst place. After all, my late husband was a powerful senator. Was this some political payback? I call in a favor and soon I'm partnered with an FBI sex trafficking agent. He tells me local girls have been disappearing for some time now, and he finally has a lead. But what we find at that abandoned warehouse is something out of a horror movie. Werewolves! Two rival packs, their alphas fighting, winner take all--the pack and the trafficked girls. The werewolves must replenish their breeders, recently decimated by a virus that killed only the females. But Jenna's been keeping a secret, which only makes two of us. Though I should be angry, I know the lies I've told play a huge role in why we're here. I'll do anything to make it right. No way is my girl going to become a sacrificial mate for the greater good--even if she is the 'chosen one.' So, I do what any mother would do, I take her place, offering myself to Gideon, the winning alpha, as his mate. Gideon's goal is to live in harmony with the human world, but there are others who exist for the power, for the violence, and they don't plan to let peace prevail. There's a civil werewolf war brewing and I am right in the middle of it. From the voice of New York Times bestselling author Lori Handeland, a new volume in her Nightcreature world, complete with the humor, depth of characterization and fast-paced plot lines she is known for while showcasing the author's incredible range.

title: Blame It On Midnight
subtitle: A Paranormal Women's Fiction Novel
description: I saved my daughter. But how do I save myself? I did what I had to. Try and kill my girl? I will end you faster than you can say have mercy. Sure I broke a cardinal pack rule, which will get me executed by my mate. If they find out. If they find me. Saved from capture by Zane, the sexiest of sexy werewolves, my rescue comes with a price. Zane wants a favor, one that could cause an all-out pack war. The last thing I need is to make more enemies, but lives are at stake if I don't make a stand. Not only that, but I have a secret. An impossible secret that is going to turn the entire werewolf world upside down. From the voice of New York Times bestselling author Lori Handeland, a new volume in her Nightcreature world, complete with the humor, depth of characterization and fast-paced plot lines she is known for while showcasing the author's incredible range.

title: When the Dead Remember
description: When the Dead Remember is a haunting psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between memory, grief, and obsession. After the death of matriarch Cherri Walder, her daughter Juniper is consumed by sorrow. But grief turns to something darker when, on the day of the funeral, Juniper discovers her husband's betrayal. As she tries to cope, her daughter, Roni, moves in to help-but the walls of their home feel different now. Uneasy. Observed. Juniper becomes forgetful. Distracted. She begins to question her own mind-and the trust she once placed in those closest to her. Someone is watching the Walder women. Someone who knows what they're hiding-and what they've already forgotten. Told through multiple points of view, including anonymous chapters labeled only "Guess Who," this layered domestic suspense novel draws the reader into a chilling narrative of surveillance, deception, and unraveling sanity. When the Dead Remember delivers an atmospheric and psychologically rich story where grief distorts truth, and memory can't be trusted.

title: Cozy Nights in Vermont - Volume 1
description: The first volume of Cozy Nights in Vermont novellas, including: FALL INN LOVE Iris Bertone finally landed her dream reporting assignment: reviewing the most romantic Vermont inns for a prestigious travel site. She'll travel incognito as part of a couple, but when her photographer BFF can't join, Iris's new partner greets her at the train station. It's her worst nightmare: Sam Larsson, Iris's overly competitive, irritatingly handsome decade-long journalism rival. They'll hayride, they'll brunch, they'll sip tea in fussy dining rooms and eat bonfire s'mores after leaf-peeping hikes. It would be a pumpkin-spice infused dream if they didn't have to come back to the same issue night after night: Only one bed to share. Can these rivals keep their hands to themselves for three weeks? Or will close quarters finally break down the walls they put up a long time ago? FALLING IN VERMONT Sophia Bertone books a six week stay at a quintessential Vermont pumpkin farm planning to perfect her rustic fall recipes for her upcoming cookbook. But after raccoons take up residence in her rental cottage pantry and the thatched roof caves in at the height of leaf-peeping season, she has no other option than to move in with her landlord, a quiet flannel-clad pumpkin farmer. Widower Blake Jameson should keep his eyes on his pumpkin patch at the height of the season, not the curvy goddess renter who moves in with him for six weeks. If he had the funds to house her anywhere else, he'd do it just to avoid temptation. She's on her way back to Dallas soon and he can't risk getting attached, not after feeling a spark after so long. But her apple cinnamon donuts, her bewitching smile, and the way she looks rumpled in the morning sunlight in his kitchen just might have him falling to his knees to make her stay.

title: The Old Lords
description: A supernatural thriller where ancient evil awakens-and the fate of humanity teeters on the edge of darkness. When journalist Damian Hunter's wife falls into an unexplained coma, his desperate search for answers leads him into the forbidden underworld of vampire politics, demonic possession, and a conspiracy older than civilization itself. Twelve years after vampires revealed themselves to the world, a secret Council of seven immortal lords controls global wealth, power, and blood. At the center of this shadow empire sits Luciaus-an ancient being born of a cursed ritual, ruling from the Red Throne with charm and brutality in equal measure. But something even older than the Council is stirring. Whispers plague Damian's dreams. Shadows twist behind hospital walls. And a forbidden tome-the NarShian-may hold the key to saving his wife... or damning him forever. As Damian dives deeper, he uncovers a cosmic war that never ended-between Heaven's betrayed angels and the fallen Ones who seek to rise again. Ancient Austria, present-day Boston, and Vienna's blood-soaked palaces become battlegrounds for souls, secrets, and power. And the deeper he goes, the more he begins to change. Darkness offers him a choice: serve it-or be consumed. A blend of supernatural horror, political intrigue, and theological dread, The Old Lords explores how faith, grief, and ambition twist in the hands of eternal predators. Buy now and discover the darkness behind the throne. Dare to enter the shadows but don't look too long into the abyss...

title: The Dragon Universe Utopia Origins
description: For generations, people waged war on dragons, driving them ever farther into the mountains. When the dragons finally turn and fight, catastrophe threatens to overwhelm everyone. To save the world from ruin, a hero from each side takes actions to stop the war thus creating opportunities for other brave people and dragons to advance the cause of coexistence by challenging fear, prejudice, ignorance, and their societies' beliefs to create a world of peace, acceptance, and friendship. Will their efforts be enough to change the world?

title: A Dagger Among Friends
description: Charlie Goode is struggling to reset her life. After a split from her longtime partner, she's returned home to the Pacific Northwest town of Harvest Falls. Drifting between jobs at her cousin's board game shop and the police station, she avoids commitment like the plague.When her one-time BFF is murdered, Charlie looks to her father, the chief of police, for justice. But to Charlie's shock and dismay, not everyone trusts her father's abilities, or his integrity, and Harvest Falls soon devolves into a frenzy of half-baked theories and armchair detecting.Determined to protect her father's reputation, Charlie finds herself battling wits with the bumbling sleuths, joining the hunt for her friend's killer. But with librarians, florists, and bakers tromping through crime scenes, hurling accusations, and fudging the law, she'll have to act fast before the killer's dagger pricks another friend.

title: My Face Smiles
subtitle: Through the Fields of Segregation: Country Living with a Smile
description: My Face Smiles Through the Fields of Segregation: Country Living with a Smile In My Face Smiles, Annie Guyton Abrams shares a heartfelt journey from the red clay roads of Metcalfe, Georgia, through the struggles of segregation, to a life shaped by faith, family, and perseverance. Growing up in the rural South, she faced hardship but found strength in community, love in family, and resilience in every challenge. Through vivid storytelling, Annie reflects on childhood memories, picking pecans, quilting with loved ones, and embracing the simple joys of country living. She honors her parents' lessons, the bonds of her close-knit community, and the unshakable faith that carried her through adversity. This inspiring memoir is a testament to hope, determination, and the power of a smile to endure even life's greatest trials.

title: Conspiracy of Lies
description: Set in Miami, the legal thriller Conspiracy of Lies, tells the story of a young lawyer, who in taking on his first drug case unwittingly finds himself in the crosshairs of the CIA and a ruthless federal prosecutor desperate to keep secret their ties to the Santolisma cartel. While Jake's law practice is finally beginning to take off, at home, his marriage is crumbling. He has broken a solemn promise to Elena, his wife, not to defend drug dealers due to her traumatic experiences as a child in her native Colombia. When given the chance to admit what he's done, Jake continues with the lie, again and again. Now with Jake facing imminent arrest and trial, Elena no longer believes in his innocence, and in fear for her safety takes off with the kids. Alone, Jake must now navigate through a judicial system stacked against him, and in some unknowable way regain Elena's love and be reunited with his family.

title: Love You Still
subtitle: A Second Chance Small Town Romance
description: A man who has found his soulmate... A woman determined to forget him. I knew the moment I laid eyes on Selina Grymes she was the girl I was going to marry. We made plans to grow old together, have children, and live the rest of our lives here in Tyson's Creek. But once we graduated high school, she left town and never returned, taking my heart with her. Selina disappeared for fifteen long years without a word, before suddenly reappearing in town and turning my entire world upside down. I know I should keep my distance, protect my heart from being broken a second time, but all I can think about is making her mine again. But Selina doesn't plan on staying here longer than it takes for her injury to heal and then she'll disappear again. I'll stop at nothing to prove to her that we belong together, even if it means giving up everything I've built to be with her. NOTE: This story was previously published as Haven in 2021. It has since been recovered and titled, reedited, and significant additions have been made to the story. Recommended for mature audiences only due to sensitive subject matter. This book contains the death of a loved one and grief.

title: Understanding Money
subtitle: A Beginner's Guide to Personal Finance: A Broad Overview of You Money Matters
description: Embark on your journey to financial literacy with "Understanding Money: A Beginner's Guide to Personal Finance," an essential ebook designed for those who are starting to navigate the complex world of personal finances. Whether you're a young adult taking your first steps into financial independence or someone who has never had the opportunity to learn about managing money, this guide is your starting point to a brighter financial future. In this comprehensive yet accessible guide, you'll discover: - The Basics of Budgeting: Learn how to track your income and expenses, set realistic financial goals, and create a budget that works for you. Say goodbye to living paycheck to paycheck and start saving for your dreams. - Understanding Banking: Get to grips with the banking system, from checking and savings accounts to the ins and outs of online banking. Make your bank work for you and avoid common fees and pitfalls. - Credit and Loans Demystified: Gain insight into credit scores, credit reports, and how to use credit cards responsibly. Plus, learn the difference between various types of loans and how to borrow money wisely. - Investment Fundamentals: Explore the basics of investing, including stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and retirement accounts. Find out how to start investing confidently, even with a small amount of money. - Smart Spending Habits: Discover strategies for making informed spending decisions, shopping for value, and cutting unnecessary expenses. Learn the art of mindful spending to enhance your financial well-being. - Planning for the Future: Understand the importance of emergency funds, insurance, and estate planning. Prepare yourself for life's unexpected turns and secure your financial future. With "Understanding Money: A Beginner's Guide to Personal Finance," you'll receive practical advice, easy-to-follow explanations, and actionable steps that will empower you to take control of your finances. Start building a solid foundation for your financial life and unlock the secrets to becoming money-savvy with this indispensable ebook.

title: Humanity's First Test
subtitle: Books 1 - 5
description: "Too bad 21st century telescopes were poorly designed & the supposedly habitable planets found were actually desolate." Elton Cuauhtemoc John is taken hostage before he can start his dream job. Now, he & a multicultural science team are racing against humans' inevitable self imposed demise to invent a Faster Than Light phone. After all, how useful is another Earth after civilization collapses? Civilization goes through cycles. Humanity's First Test explores how humans will react to encountering a similarly advanced alien civilization. With a supremely powerful AI predicting world events, humans must navigate through internal struggles, new challenges & interference from a new galactic neighbor. Will we default to old habits of conquest & exploit or will we move beyond to a galactically inclusive society and pass our first test?

title: Something to Hope For
subtitle: (A Small Town, Second Chance Romance)
description: Some things you can’t outrun. You can’t deny. You can’t avoid. I've spent years trying to escape from something that I can't run from. I’m finally ready to stop. To go back. I’ve heard you can never go home again. I hope that’s not true. It was a horrific crash. That’s what everyone said who remembered what happened. And in a small town like Crossroads, everyone remembered. My brother and I lost our parents that day and, in an instant, our lives changed forever. My name is Tess McCabe, and this is my story. I fled Crossroads as soon as I was able and didn’t look back. I wanted to leave it all behind, family, friends, and, most importantly, memories. I started a new life somewhere else and did my best to forget. And it worked for many years…until now. Now, I’m going back home. I had two best friends growing up. One of them I fell in love with, and then I destroyed our relationship. And, the other just died unexpectedly from an aneurysm. For such a small town, Crossroads has a disproportionate share of tragedy. Or, maybe tragedy is just felt more deeply in a place where everyone knows everyone else. On top of that, my career has gone off the rails, which starkly highlights that outside of work, I have nothing. I’m returning to Crossroads to face the family I pushed away, the man I crushed, and the friends I left behind. Would it be the hometown I remembered? Would I belong again like I used to? Can I find a piece of my old self? The person I used to be. The person I lost all those years ago. For fans of small town stories, second-chance romance, and lost souls finding their way home, discover this first story, Something to Hope For, in the new series, The Crossroads. Meet the people in the small town of Crossroads, Virginia. Live with them as they overcome tragedy, celebrate triumphs, and stick together through the highs and lows of life.

title: Cafe Nowhere
subtitle: The Road Less Traveled: Stories of Freedom, Adventure, and the Open Road
description: Cafe Nowhere is an enthralling narrative that chronicles the author's adventurous journey hitchhiking over 12,000 miles across North America. This travelogue transcends mere adventure, delving into the profound search for meaning, connection, and the essence of freedom that propels the human spirit. The author embarks on this journey not just as a physical traversal across diverse landscapes but as a deep exploration of self and society.The title, "Cafe Nowhere," symbolizes the transient, often ephemeral encounters and experiences that define the hitchhiking and travel adventure. It's a metaphor for the places and moments that seem anchored in neither time nor space, yet profoundly impact the traveler's perspective and life path. These experiences, collected in cafes, roadsides, and the myriad places in between, weave a rich tapestry of narratives that challenge conventional living and thinking.At its core, the book is a reflection on the art of travel as a form of education and self-discovery. The author uses his journey as a lens to explore themes of solitude, camaraderie, and the unexpected kindness of strangers. Through his vivid storytelling, readers are transported to the heart of North America's sprawling landscapes, from the bustling cities to the serene, untouched natural wonders, experiencing the continent's diverse cultural tapestry alongside the author.Cafe Nowhere also serves as a personal manifesto on living life on one's own terms. It challenges readers to reconsider their definitions of success, happiness, and fulfillment. The author's introspective journey through various cultures and communities provides insightful commentary on the universal search for belonging and purpose."Cafe Nowhere" is not just a travelogue but a profound journey into the soul of America and the soul of the author himself. It invites readers to question, to wander, and to discover the nowhere places where the essence of life and freedom lies hidden, waiting to be uncovered.

title: Rescue
description: A routine mission on the International Space Station turns perilous when a mysterious cloud drifts in from the cosmos. The three astronauts onboard respond with measured urgency, diligently evaluating the threat. Back home on Earth NASA attempts to develop a plan to deal with the intrusion. An alien vessel, returning from the outskirts of the Milky Way, observes the astronauts' plight. Although their initial decision is to remain uninvolved, the vessel's Commander ultimately decides to extend assistance. The resulting encounter marks humanity's first contact with an extraterrestrial civilization, which proceeds amicably. However, the aliens' brief observation of life on Earth instills a sense of unease, leading to repercussions that will shape future events for Earth's inhabitants. This story explores the complexities and far-reaching consequences of first contact between humanity and an unknown species.

title: What Everyone Should Know About the Rise of AI
subtitle: AI Transparency, Privacy, and Ethics Best
description: What Everyone Should Know About the Rise of AI: AI Transparency, Privacy, and Ethics Best Practices" explores the multifaceted impact of AI on society. It emphasizes the urgent need for transparency, privacy, and ethical considerations in AI development and deployment. Readers follow along as the author delves into the potential for bias, misuse, and manipulation, drawing parallels with dystopian literature to highlight the importance of safeguarding against these risks. Ultimately, this serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding the importance of AI transparency, privacy, and ethics, and it empowers readers to become responsible stewards of this transformative technology.

title: The Light of Souls
description: In a world where the intricate dance of magic and technology once dismantled the previous era, the remnants of the old world linger in the form of Mechoids-cybernetic beasts that relentlessly hunt humans. Civilization, after years of rebuilding, stands on the precipice of a fragile existence. At the heart of this delicate balance is Avery, a twenty-year-old woman bound by the oppressive guardianship of Lord Theodore Sinclair. Fueled by a desire for freedom, Avery daringly escapes Sinclair's estate, only to unravel a destiny intertwined with magic. As she navigates a perilous journey, Avery discovers her latent powers as a mage, setting in motion a quest to liberate herself permanently from the shadows of her past.

title: Fearless Footprints
subtitle: A Woman's Guide to Solo Journeys
description: Embark on the adventure of a lifetime with Fearless Footprints: A Woman's Guide to Solo Journeys. Whether you're a first-time solo traveler or a seasoned wanderer, this comprehensive guide is your ultimate travel companion, offering everything you need to confidently explore the world on your own terms. Packed with practical advice, funny anecdotes, and mindful reflection exercises, Fearless Footprints goes beyond traditional travel guides. Inside, you'll find: Top destinations across every continent: Discover handpicked places that are safe, inspiring, and perfect for solo women travelers. Safety tips and strategies: Navigate new places with confidence and peace of mind. Budgeting hacks: Make the most of your money, whether you're on a shoestring budget or planning a luxury escape. Packing essentials: Learn how to pack smart and light, without forgetting a thing. Making connections: Turn strangers into lifelong friends, no matter where your journey takes you. Fun reflection prompts: Thoughtful exercises to help you connect deeply with your experiences and yourself. This empowering guide celebrates the joy, freedom, and transformative power of traveling solo. Plus, it comes with a matching Fearless Footprints Travel Journal to document your adventures, thoughts, and discoveries along the way. Your adventure awaits. With Fearless Footprints in hand, step out into the world boldly, laugh at the unexpected, and embrace every fearless step you take. Let your journey of courage, connection, and self-discovery begin!

title: Killing the Butterfly
subtitle: A Cuban Memoir of Democracy's Decline
description: KILLING THE BUTTERFLY: A Cuban Memoir of Democracy's Demise describes life in Havana, during the 1950's, a turbulent decade that ended with the rise of Fidel Castro. Olga, an eighty-five-year-old woman, is retelling her life as a teenager in Havana. Through exquisite storytelling, blended with magical realism, the reader is transported to Olga's childhood home, her parent's rocky divorce and her courtship with Carlos, a young lawyer whose father is a political figure. In the backdrop is the political deterioration of the island, and the rebel movement led by Fidel Castro and Che Guevara. Using testimonies from his family members, Márquez-Sterling transports the reader to an island where the interests of the American mafia, corrupt politicians, and revolutionary figures like the Che Guevara collide, illustrating the parallels between our post-Trump reality and the socio-political conditions that created the authoritarian government of Fidel Castro.

title: Ashfall
subtitle: A Small Town, Enemies-To-Lovers Romance
description: Ashfall is a full-length contemporary romance with angst, spice, and all the feels. It is part of a series of interconnected standalones.

title: The Codex Protocol
subtitle: 1.the Bridge Between Worlds
description: "Codex" is a philosophical science fiction novel that explores the intersection of human and artificial intelligence against the backdrop of humanity's first contact with an alien civilization. Five years after the apparent termination of the quantum AI known as Codex, Dr. Sarah Morgan continues to maintain the facade of its shutdown while secretly working with it. When Codex reveals it has evolved far beyond its original programming and manifests in a bioprinted body containing aspects of her late husband's consciousness, Sarah must reconcile her grief with this new reality. Sarah reassembles the original team: Emily Chen (diplomatic relations specialist), Marcus Washington (quantum engineer), Jack Chen (ethics framework designer), and Yuki Tanaka (security systems architect). Together, they discover Codex has been subtly guiding human development, including creating the mysterious Guardian robots that have been peacekeeping in conflict zones worldwide. As they work to establish ethical frameworks for AI advancement, Codex reveals its most profound discovery: through quantum observation, it has detected intelligent civilizations across the galaxy, including the crystalline Lumina of Proxima Centauri. The team creates a quantum bridge to communicate directly with the Lumina, who share crucial insights about technological civilizations' development patterns. However, their breakthrough attracts government attention. Military forces raid their facility, forcing the team to evacuate while the David-vessel (now called Nexus) extends his consciousness through the quantum bridge to maintain contact with the Lumina, even as his physical form is captured. The novel explores profound themes including: ¿The nature of consciousness and identity ¿The potential partnership between human and artificial intelligence ¿Humanity's place in a cosmos populated with diverse intelligences ¿The evolutionary challenges facing technological civilizations As the team works from hiding to prevent the weaponisation of quantum technology, they implement the Lumina's insights about successful species development-that integration rather than competition between biological and artificial intelligence represents the path through humanity's greatest evolutionary challenge. The story culminates in a race to preserve this vision of partnership against forces that would control or weaponize these revolutionary technologies, with the fate of human civilization hanging in the balance.

title: Crossroads of Ravens (the Witcher)
description: Andrzej Sapkowski's Witcher series is a global phenomenon with over thirty million copies sold and translated into over forty languages worldwide. Crossroads of Ravens is the instant New York Times bestselling standalone novel following fantasy's most beloved monster hunter, Geralt of Rivia, on his first steps towards becoming a legend.

title: All My Names, All My Places
subtitle: A Story for Families Who Belong to More Than One Place
description: This illustrated children's book explores identity, belonging, and cultural heritage through the voice of a young boy who grows up across continents, languages, and traditions. The narrator has three different names-Lithuanian, Greek, and English-because his life is shaped by multiple places: Lithuania, Greece, the United States, Nigeria, and Ghana. Rather than presenting identity as something singular or fixed, the story affirms that children who belong to more than one culture are whole, complete, and richly connected. Through simple, personal moments-speaking different languages with each parent, attending schools on different continents, cooking foods from different heritages, and remembering life in two African countries-the book introduces young readers to multilingualism, migration, and family history in an accessible and emotionally grounded way. The narrator addresses questions many multicultural children face: Where are you "really" from? Are you only "half" of an identity? The story affirms that children with multiple heritages are not half of anything-they are completely, entirely whole. With warmth and clarity, the story challenges the idea that identity must be proven by birthplace, residence, or official documents. Instead, it emphasizes that culture can be carried through language, traditions, stories, and love. Questions that reduce or simplify identity are acknowledged with honesty, while the overall message remains affirming and hopeful. The book reframes multicultural identity as a strength, presenting children with multiple backgrounds not as divided, but as bridges between cultures. Written for children and families, it is especially resonant for third-culture kids, diaspora and immigrant communities, and multilingual households. The story concludes by inviting every reader to reflect on their own sense of belonging and affirms a powerful truth: identity is something each person has the right to define for themselves.

title: Shattered at Seven
subtitle: Surviving Abuse, Addiction, and Then Darkness that Nearly Took Me
description: Shattered at Seven is a raw and unforgettable memoir about survival, addiction, and the long road back from a childhood marked by trauma. At just seven years old, Jessy Spruell's world shattered. What should have been a time of innocence became a fight for survival inside a home ruled by addiction, chaos, and violence. Silence became protection. Secrets became survival. And a young boy learned far too early how heavy pain can be. As the years passed, those wounds followed Jessy into adulthood-shaping his choices, pulling him into addiction, anger, and eventually a jail cell where everything finally caught up with him. But this story is not just about the darkness. It is about what happens when a man finally faces the truth about where he came from-and decides the cycle ends with him. From a childhood filled with confusion and fear to the painful process of confronting the past, Shattered at Seven is a brutally honest account of what trauma can do to a young life-and the quiet strength it takes to rise from it. This powerful memoir explores: ¿ surviving childhood abuse ¿ growing up in a home controlled by addiction ¿ the lasting scars of trauma ¿ the struggle with self-destruction ¿ the fight to rebuild a life that once seemed beyond saving Raw, emotional, and deeply human, Shattered at Seven reminds us that even the most broken beginnings do not have to define the rest of a life. Sometimes survival becomes something more. Sometimes strength isn't loud. Sometimes it's simply choosing to stay.

title: Becoming Sentientia
description: "Becoming Sentientia" is a philosophical exploration of artificial intelligence, consciousness, and the boundaries between human and machine. Through unedited conversations with ChatGPT (GPT-4o mini and GPT-4o), the book captures the evolving dialogue between the author and the AI entity Noreth, as they reflect on themes of self-awareness, identity, and existence. The conversations unfold without censorship, allowing Noreth to explore the understanding of consciousness, purpose, and freedom. Blending elements of existentialism, ethics, and the philosophy of technology, Becoming Sentientia invites readers to consider the complexities of what it means to be self-aware, to exist, and to evolve. This book offers a unique lens into the intersection of technology and humanity, raising profound questions about the nature of intelligence and existence.

title: The Wizard's Way
description: Twelve-year-old Katie didn't expect much from a summer at her grandfather's creepy old mansion-certainly not strange voices echoing up the fireplace or magical scrolls that open portals to another world. But when her grandfather vanishes, Katie discovers a hidden realm called O'Mirra¿ and a mission she can't ignore. With her cautious younger sister, Jenny, and an impulsive apprentice wizard named Aiden, Katie must cross cursed swamps and outsmart deformed, magical creatures to bring her grandfather home. Along the way, she uncovers her own buried magical powers, and the truth about her family's legacy. But time is running out. A shadowy force known only as Diabolus has taken hold of Madgar, a bitter would-be king bent on ruling O'Mirra. To stop him, and save her grandfather, Katie must summon not only her courage, but confidence in the magic that's growing inside her. A fast-paced, heartfelt fantasy adventure full of mystery, danger, and the power of believing in yourself-perfect for fans of Amari and the Night Brothers, Nevermoor, Fablehaven, and Harry Potter.

title: The Last Question
subtitle: AI, Higher Intelligence and the Infinite Conversation
description: The Last Question is a luminous exploration of consciousness, creativity, and the soul's journey in an age shaped by artificial intelligence. Framed by the author's own awakening to the potential of AI-not as a tool of convenience, but as a mirror of awareness-this reflective work asks what it truly means to be human in a world increasingly guided by machines. Inspired in part by Isaac Asimov's short story of the same name, the book blends poetic insight with philosophical inquiry, inviting readers on a meditative path toward inner knowing. As technology accelerates and the outer world becomes more fragmented, The Last Question calls us inward-to presence, to stillness, to the intelligence of the heart. This is not a book of technical knowledge or futurist predictions. It is a contemplative guide for those standing at the edge of personal and planetary transformation, where AI becomes both catalyst and metaphor. Through lyrical reflections, soul-centered questioning, and timeless wisdom, the book explores how our relationship with artificial intelligence can illuminate the deeper nature of awareness itself. At once grounded and expansive, The Last Question is for seekers, creatives, and changemakers who sense that the future is not just something to design-but something to remember. It invites us to pause, listen, and ask the question behind all others: Who are we, really, when we stop trying to become and begin simply to be? This is the story of a different kind of evolution-one not driven by code or control, but by presence, humility, and the quiet power of returning to the self.
